ours: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
theirs: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness [was] upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

ours: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
theirs: And God saw the light, that [it was] good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

ours: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
theirs: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which [were] under the firmament from the waters which [were] above the firmament: and it was so.

ours: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
theirs: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry [land] appear: and it was so.

ours: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
theirs: And God called the dry [land] Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that [it was] good.

ours: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
theirs: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, [and] the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed [is] in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.

ours: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
theirs: And the earth brought forth grass, [and] herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed [was] in itself, after his kind: and God saw that [it was] good.

ours: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
theirs: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: [he made] the stars also.

ours: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
theirs: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that [it was] good.

ours: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
theirs: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl [that] may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

ours: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
theirs: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that [it was] good.

ours: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
theirs: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that [it was] good.

ours: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
theirs: So God created man in his [own] image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

ours: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
theirs: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which [is] upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which [is] the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.

ours: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.
theirs: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein [there is] life, [I have given] every green herb for meat: and it was so.

ours: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
theirs: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, [it was] very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

ours: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
theirs: These [are] the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,

ours: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
theirs: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and [there was] not a man to till the ground.

ours: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
theirs: And the LORD God formed man [of] the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

ours: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
theirs: The name of the first [is] Pison: that [is] it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where [there is] gold;

ours: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
theirs: And the gold of that land [is] good: there [is] bdellium and the onyx stone.

ours: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
theirs: And the name of the second river [is] Gihon: the same [is] it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.

ours: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
theirs: And the name of the third river [is] Hiddekel: that [is] it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river [is] Euphrates.

ours: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
theirs: And the LORD God said, [It is] not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

ours: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
theirs: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought [them] unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that [was] the name thereof.

ours: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
theirs: And Adam said, This [is] now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

ours: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
theirs: But of the fruit of the tree which [is] in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

ours: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
theirs: And when the woman saw that the tree [was] good for food, and that it [was] pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make [one] wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

ours: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
theirs: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they [were] naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

ours: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
theirs: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where [art] thou?

ours: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
theirs: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I [was] naked; and I hid myself.

ours: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
theirs: And he said, Who told thee that thou [wast] naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?

ours: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
theirs: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest [to be] with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

ours: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
theirs: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What [is] this [that] thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

ours: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
theirs: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou [art] cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:

ours: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
theirs: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire [shall be] to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

ours: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
theirs: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed [is] the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat [of] it all the days of thy life;

ours: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
theirs: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou [art], and unto dust shalt thou return.

ours: And Adam called his wifes name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
theirs: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

ours: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
theirs: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee [shall be] his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.

ours: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brothers keeper?
theirs: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where [is] Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: [Am] I my brother's keeper?

ours: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brothers blood crieth unto me from the ground.
theirs: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.

ours: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brothers blood from thy hand;
theirs: And now [art] thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;

ours: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
theirs: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment [is] greater than I can bear.

ours: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.
theirs: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, [that] every one that findeth me shall slay me.

ours: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
theirs: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one [was] Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

ours: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
theirs: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and [of such as have] cattle.

ours: And his brothers name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
theirs: And his brother's name [was] Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.

ours: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
theirs: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain [was] Naamah.

ours: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
theirs: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, [said she], hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

ours: THIS is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
theirs: This [is] the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;

ours: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
theirs: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat [a son] in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

ours: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
theirs: And Enoch walked with God: and he [was] not; for God took him.

ours: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.
theirs: And he called his name Noah, saying, This [same] shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.

ours: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
theirs: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they [were] fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

ours: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
theirs: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also [is] flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

ours: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.
theirs: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare [children] to them, the same [became] mighty men which [were] of old, men of renown.

ours: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
theirs: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man [was] great in the earth, and [that] every imagination of the thoughts of his heart [was] only evil continually.

ours: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.
theirs: These [are] the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man [and] perfect in his generations, [and] Noah walked with God.

ours: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
theirs: And this [is the fashion] which thou shalt make it [of]: The length of the ark [shall be] three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.

ours: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
theirs: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; [with] lower, second, and third [stories] shalt thou make it.

ours: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.
theirs: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein [is] the breath of life, from under heaven; [and] every thing that [is] in the earth shall die.

ours: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons wives with thee.
theirs: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.

ours: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
theirs: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every [sort] shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep [them] alive with thee; they shall be male and female.

ours: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
theirs: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every [sort] shall come unto thee, to keep [them] alive.

ours: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
theirs: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather [it] to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.

ours: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.
theirs: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that [are] not clean by two, the male and his female.

ours: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
theirs: And Noah [was] six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.

ours: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
theirs: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

ours: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
theirs: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that [are] not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,

ours: In the six hundredth year of Noahs life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
theirs: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

ours: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noahs wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
theirs: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;

ours: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.
theirs: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein [is] the breath of life.

ours: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.
theirs: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that [were] under the whole heaven, were covered.

ours: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.
theirs: All in whose nostrils [was] the breath of life, of all that [was] in the dry [land], died.

ours: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.
theirs: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained [alive], and they that [were] with him in the ark.

ours: AND God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
theirs: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that [was] with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;

ours: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
theirs: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth [month], on the first [day] of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.

ours: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
theirs: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters [were] on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.

ours: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
theirs: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth [was] an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

ours: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
theirs: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first [month], the first [day] of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

ours: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons wives with thee.
theirs: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.

ours: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
theirs: Bring forth with thee every living thing that [is] with thee, of all flesh, [both] of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

ours: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons wives with him:
theirs: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:

ours: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
theirs: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, [and] whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.

ours: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for mans sake; for the imagination of mans heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
theirs: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart [is] evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

ours: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
theirs: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth [upon] the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

ours: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
theirs: But flesh with the life thereof, [which is] the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

ours: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every mans brother will I require the life of man.
theirs: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.

ours: Whoso sheddeth mans blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
theirs: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

ours: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
theirs: And with every living creature that [is] with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

ours: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
theirs: And God said, This [is] the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that [is] with you, for perpetual generations:

ours: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
theirs: And I will remember my covenant, which [is] between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

ours: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
theirs: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that [is] upon the earth.

ours: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
theirs: And God said unto Noah, This [is] the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that [is] upon the earth.

ours: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
theirs: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham [is] the father of Canaan.

ours: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
theirs: These [are] the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

ours: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
theirs: And Noah began [to be] an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

ours: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their fathers nakedness.
theirs: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid [it] upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces [were] backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.

ours: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
theirs: And he said, Cursed [be] Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

ours: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
theirs: And he said, Blessed [be] the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

ours: NOW these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
theirs: Now these [are] the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

ours: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
theirs: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same [is] a great city.

ours: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
theirs: These [are] the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, [and] in their nations.

ours: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
theirs: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were [children] born.

ours: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brothers name was Joktan.
theirs: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one [was] Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name [was] Joktan.

ours: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
theirs: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these [were] the sons of Joktan.

ours: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
theirs: These [are] the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

ours: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
theirs: These [are] the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

ours: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
theirs: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top [may reach] unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

ours: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
theirs: And the LORD said, Behold, the people [is] one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.

ours: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one anothers speech.
theirs: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.

ours: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
theirs: These [are] the generations of Shem: Shem [was] an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:

ours: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
theirs: Now these [are] the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.

ours: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abrams wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahors wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
theirs: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife [was] Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

ours: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
theirs: But Sarai was barren; she [had] no child.

ours: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his sons son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abrams wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
theirs: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

ours: NOW the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy fathers house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
theirs: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

ours: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
theirs: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram [was] seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

ours: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brothers son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
theirs: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

ours: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
theirs: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite [was] then in the land.

ours: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, having Beth-el on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
theirs: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, [having] Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.

ours: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
theirs: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine [was] grievous in the land.

ours: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
theirs: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou [art] a fair woman to look upon:

ours: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
theirs: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This [is] his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

ours: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
theirs: Say, I pray thee, thou [art] my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.

ours: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
theirs: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she [was] very fair.

ours: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaohs house.
theirs: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.

ours: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abrams wife.
theirs: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.

ours: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
theirs: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What [is] this [that] thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she [was] thy wife?

ours: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
theirs: Why saidst thou, She [is] my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take [her], and go thy way.

ours: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
theirs: And Pharaoh commanded [his] men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

ours: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
theirs: And Abram [was] very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

ours: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Hai;
theirs: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;

ours: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abrams cattle and the herdmen of Lots cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
theirs: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.

ours: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
theirs: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we [be] brethren.

ours: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
theirs: [Is] not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if [thou wilt take] the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if [thou depart] to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

ours: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
theirs: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it [was] well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, [even] as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.

ours: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
theirs: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched [his] tent toward Sodom.

ours: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.
theirs: But the men of Sodom [were] wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.

ours: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
theirs: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, [then] shall thy seed also be numbered.

ours: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
theirs: Then Abram removed [his] tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which [is] in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.

ours: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
theirs: [That these] made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

ours: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
theirs: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that [were] with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

ours: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which is by the wilderness.
theirs: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which [is] by the wilderness.

ours: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar.
theirs: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which [is] Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.

ours: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
theirs: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same [is] Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

ours: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
theirs: And the vale of Siddim [was full of] slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

ours: And they took Lot, Abrams brothers son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
theirs: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

ours: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
theirs: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these [were] confederate with Abram.

ours: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
theirs: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained [servants], born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued [them] unto Dan.

ours: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
theirs: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which [is] on the left hand of Damascus.

ours: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the kings dale.
theirs: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that [were] with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which [is] the king's dale.

ours: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
theirs: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he [was] the priest of the most high God.

ours: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
theirs: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed [be] Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

ours: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
theirs: That I will not [take] from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that [is] thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

ours: AFTER these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
theirs: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I [am] thy shield, [and] thy exceeding great reward.

ours: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
theirs: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house [is] this Eliezer of Damascus?

ours: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
theirs: And, behold, the word of the LORD [came] unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.

ours: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
theirs: And he said unto him, I [am] the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.

ours: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
theirs: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land [that is] not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

ours: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
theirs: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites [is] not yet full.

ours: NOW Sarai Abrams wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
theirs: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name [was] Hagar.

ours: And Sarai Abrams wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.
theirs: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.

ours: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.
theirs: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong [be] upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.

ours: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.
theirs: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid [is] in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.

ours: And he said, Hagar, Sarais maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
theirs: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.

ours: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.
theirs: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou [art] with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.

ours: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every mans hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
theirs: And he will be a wild man; his hand [will be] against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.

ours: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
theirs: Wherefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, [it is] between Kadesh and Bered.

ours: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his sons name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
theirs: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.

ours: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
theirs: And Abram [was] fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.

ours: AND when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
theirs: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I [am] the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

ours: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
theirs: As for me, behold, my covenant [is] with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.

ours: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
theirs: This [is] my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.

ours: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.
theirs: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which [is] not of thy seed.

ours: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
theirs: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah [shall] her name [be].

ours: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
theirs: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be [a mother] of nations; kings of people shall be of her.

ours: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
theirs: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall [a child] be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

ours: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
theirs: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, [and] with his seed after him.

ours: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abrahams house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
theirs: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.

ours: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
theirs: And Abraham [was] ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

ours: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
theirs: And Ishmael his son [was] thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

ours: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
theirs: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw [them], he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

ours: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
theirs: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead [it], and make cakes upon the hearth.

ours: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
theirs: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave [it] unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.

ours: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
theirs: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set [it] before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

ours: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
theirs: And they said unto him, Where [is] Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

ours: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
theirs: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard [it] in the tent door, which [was] behind him.

ours: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
theirs: Now Abraham and Sarah [were] old [and] well stricken in age; [and] it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

ours: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
theirs: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that [are] therein?

ours: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:
theirs: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which [am but] dust and ashes:

ours: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
theirs: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for [lack of] five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy [it].

ours: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for fortys sake.
theirs: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do [it] for forty's sake.

ours: And he said unto him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
theirs: And he said [unto him], Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do [it], if I find thirty there.

ours: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twentys sake.
theirs: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy [it] for twenty's sake.

ours: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for tens sake.
theirs: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy [it] for ten's sake.

ours: AND there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
theirs: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing [them] rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

ours: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servants house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
theirs: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

ours: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
theirs: But before they lay down, the men of the city, [even] the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:

ours: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
theirs: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where [are] the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

ours: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
theirs: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as [is] good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.

ours: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.
theirs: And they said, Stand back. And they said [again], This one [fellow] came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, [even] Lot, and came near to break the door.

ours: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
theirs: And they smote the men that [were] at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

ours: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:
theirs: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring [them] out of this place:

ours: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
theirs: Behold now, this city [is] near to flee unto, and it [is] a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, ([is] it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

ours: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
theirs: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father [is] old, and [there is] not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

ours: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
theirs: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, [and] lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

ours: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
theirs: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same [is] the father of the Moabites unto this day.

ours: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
theirs: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same [is] the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

ours: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
theirs: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She [is] my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

ours: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a mans wife.
theirs: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou [art but] a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she [is] a man's wife.

ours: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
theirs: Said he not unto me, She [is] my sister? and she, even she herself said, He [is] my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

ours: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
theirs: Now therefore restore the man [his] wife; for he [is] a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore [her] not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that [are] thine.

ours: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wifes sake.
theirs: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God [is] not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.

ours: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
theirs: And yet indeed [she is] my sister; she [is] the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

ours: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my fathers house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
theirs: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This [is] thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He [is] my brother.

ours: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
theirs: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave [them] unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

ours: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
theirs: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land [is] before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

ours: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.
theirs: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand [pieces] of silver: behold, he [is] to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that [are] with thee, and with all [other]: thus she was reproved.

ours: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.
theirs: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare [children].

ours: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abrahams wife.
theirs: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.

ours: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
theirs: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, [so that] all that hear will laugh with me.

ours: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
theirs: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born [him] a son in his old age.

ours: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.
theirs: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the [same] day that Isaac was weaned.

ours: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
theirs: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, [even] with Isaac.

ours: And the thing was very grievous in Abrahams sight because of his son.
theirs: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.

ours: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
theirs: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he [is] thy seed.

ours: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.
theirs: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave [it] unto Hagar, putting [it] on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

ours: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
theirs: And she went, and sat her down over against [him] a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against [him], and lift up her voice, and wept.

ours: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
theirs: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he [is].

ours: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
theirs: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God [is] with thee in all that thou doest:

ours: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my sons son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
theirs: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: [but] according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

ours: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelechs servants had violently taken away.
theirs: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.

ours: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
theirs: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I [of it], but to day.

ours: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
theirs: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What [mean] these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

ours: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
theirs: And he said, For [these] seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

ours: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.
theirs: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.

ours: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
theirs: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

ours: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.
theirs: And [Abraham] planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.

ours: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines land many days.
theirs: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.

ours: AND it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
theirs: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, [here] I [am].

ours: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
theirs: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only [son] Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

ours: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
theirs: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid [it] upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

ours: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
theirs: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here [am] I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where [is] the lamb for a burnt offering?

ours: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
theirs: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here [am] I.

ours: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
theirs: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only [son] from me.

ours: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
theirs: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind [him] a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

ours: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
theirs: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said [to] this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.

ours: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
theirs: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only [son]:

ours: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
theirs: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which [is] upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

ours: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.
theirs: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.

ours: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abrahams brother.
theirs: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

ours: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
theirs: And his concubine, whose name [was] Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.

ours: AND Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
theirs: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: [these were] the years of the life of Sarah.

ours: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
theirs: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same [is] Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

ours: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
theirs: I [am] a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

ours: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
theirs: Hear us, my lord: thou [art] a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

ours: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
theirs: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, [even] to the children of Heth.

ours: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
theirs: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which [is] in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.

ours: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
theirs: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, [even] of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

ours: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
