theirs: These [are] the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

ours: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esaus son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esaus wife.
theirs: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these [were] the sons of Adah Esau's wife.

ours: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esaus wife.
theirs: And these [are] the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

ours: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esaus wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
theirs: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

ours: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
theirs: These [were] dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn [son] of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,

ours: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
theirs: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, [and] duke Amalek: these [are] the dukes [that came] of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these [were] the sons of Adah.

ours: And these are the sons of Reuel Esaus son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esaus wife.
theirs: And these [are] the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these [are] the dukes [that came] of Reuel in the land of Edom; these [are] the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

ours: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esaus wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esaus wife.
theirs: And these [are] the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these [were] the dukes [that came] of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

ours: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.
theirs: These [are] the sons of Esau, who [is] Edom, and these [are] their dukes.

ours: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
theirs: These [are] the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

ours: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
theirs: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these [are] the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

ours: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotans sister was Timna.
theirs: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister [was] Timna.

ours: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
theirs: And the children of Shobal [were] these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

ours: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
theirs: And these [are] the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this [was that] Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

ours: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
theirs: And the children of Anah [were] these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

ours: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
theirs: And these [are] the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

ours: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
theirs: The children of Ezer [are] these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

ours: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.
theirs: The children of Dishan [are] these; Uz, and Aran.

ours: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
theirs: These [are] the dukes [that came] of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,

ours: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
theirs: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these [are] the dukes [that came] of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.

ours: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
theirs: And these [are] the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

ours: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
theirs: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city [was] Dinhabah.

ours: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
theirs: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city [was] Avith.

ours: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
theirs: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth [by] the river reigned in his stead.

ours: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
theirs: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

ours: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wifes name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
theirs: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city [was] Pau; and his wife's name [was] Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

ours: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
theirs: And these [are] the names of the dukes [that came] of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,

ours: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.
theirs: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these [be] the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he [is] Esau the father of the Edomites.

ours: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his fathers wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.
theirs: These [are] the generations of Jacob. Joseph, [being] seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad [was] with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

ours: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.
theirs: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he [was] the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of [many] colours.

ours: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
theirs: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told [it] his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

ours: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
theirs: For, behold, we [were] binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

ours: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
theirs: And he told [it] to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What [is] this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

ours: And his brethren went to feed their fathers flock in Shechem.
theirs: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.

ours: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
theirs: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed [the flock] in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here [am I].

ours: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
theirs: And a certain man found him, and, behold, [he was] wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

ours: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.
theirs: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed [their flocks].

ours: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.
theirs: And Reuben heard [it], and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

ours: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.
theirs: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, [but] cast him into this pit that [is] in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

ours: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;
theirs: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, [his] coat of [many] colours that [was] on him;

ours: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
theirs: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit [was] empty, [there was] no water in it.

ours: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
theirs: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry [it] down to Egypt.

ours: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?
theirs: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit [is it] if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

ours: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.
theirs: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he [is] our brother [and] our flesh. And his brethren were content.

ours: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
theirs: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty [pieces] of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

ours: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
theirs: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph [was] not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

ours: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?
theirs: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child [is] not; and I, whither shall I go?

ours: And they took Josephs coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
theirs: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

ours: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy sons coat or no.
theirs: And they sent the coat of [many] colours, and they brought [it] to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it [be] thy son's coat or no.

ours: And he knew it, and said, It is my sons coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
theirs: And he knew it, and said, [It is] my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.

ours: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaohs, and captain of the guard.
theirs: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, [and] captain of the guard.

ours: AND it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
theirs: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name [was] Hirah.

ours: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
theirs: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name [was] Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.

ours: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.
theirs: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name [was] Tamar.

ours: And Er, Judahs firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.
theirs: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.

ours: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brothers wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
theirs: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

ours: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brothers wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
theirs: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled [it] on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

ours: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy fathers house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her fathers house.
theirs: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren [did]. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.

ours: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judahs wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
theirs: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

ours: And she put her widows garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
theirs: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which [is] by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

ours: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.
theirs: When Judah saw her, he thought her [to be] an harlot; because she had covered her face.

ours: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
theirs: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she [was] his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

ours: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
theirs: And he said, I will send [thee] a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give [me] a pledge, till thou send [it]?

ours: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
theirs: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that [is] in thine hand. And he gave [it] her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

ours: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the womans hand: but he found her not.
theirs: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive [his] pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.

ours: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.
theirs: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where [is] the harlot, that [was] openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this [place].

ours: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.
theirs: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, [that] there was no harlot in this [place].

ours: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
theirs: And Judah said, Let her take [it] to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

ours: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
theirs: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she [is] with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

ours: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
theirs: When she [was] brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these [are, am] I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose [are] these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

ours: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
theirs: And Judah acknowledged [them], and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

ours: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
theirs: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins [were] in her womb.

ours: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
theirs: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that [the one] put out [his] hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

ours: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.
theirs: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? [this] breach [be] upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

ours: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
theirs: And his master saw that the LORD [was] with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

ours: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
theirs: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all [that] he had he put into his hand.

ours: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptians house for Josephs sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.
theirs: And it came to pass from the time [that] he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.

ours: And he left all that he had in Josephs hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.
theirs: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was [a] goodly [person], and well favoured.

ours: And it came to pass after these things, that his masters wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
theirs: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

ours: But he refused, and said unto his masters wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;
theirs: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what [is] with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

ours: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
theirs: [There is] none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou [art] his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

ours: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
theirs: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, [or] to be with her.

ours: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
theirs: And it came to pass about this time, that [Joseph] went into the house to do his business; and [there was] none of the men of the house there within.

ours: And Josephs master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the kings prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
theirs: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners [were] bound: and he was there in the prison.

ours: And the keeper of the prison committed to Josephs hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
theirs: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that [were] in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer [of it].

ours: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and that which he did, the LORD made it to prosper.
theirs: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing [that was] under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and [that] which he did, the LORD made [it] to prosper.

ours: AND it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.
theirs: And it came to pass after these things, [that] the butler of the king of Egypt and [his] baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

ours: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
theirs: And Pharaoh was wroth against two [of] his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

ours: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
theirs: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph [was] bound.

ours: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.
theirs: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which [were] bound in the prison.

ours: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.
theirs: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they [were] sad.

ours: And he asked Pharaohs officers that were with him in the ward of his lords house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?
theirs: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that [were] with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Wherefore look ye [so] sadly to day?

ours: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.
theirs: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and [there is] no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, [Do] not interpretations [belong] to God? tell me [them], I pray you.

ours: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
theirs: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine [was] before me;

ours: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
theirs: And in the vine [were] three branches: and it [was] as though it budded, [and] her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:

ours: And Pharaohs cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaohs cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaohs hand.
theirs: And Pharaoh's cup [was] in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

ours: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:
theirs: And Joseph said unto him, This [is] the interpretation of it: The three branches [are] three days:

ours: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaohs cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
theirs: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

ours: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:
theirs: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also [was] in my dream, and, behold, [I had] three white baskets on my head:

ours: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
theirs: And in the uppermost basket [there was] of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

ours: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:
theirs: And Joseph answered and said, This [is] the interpretation thereof: The three baskets [are] three days:

ours: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaohs birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
theirs: And it came to pass the third day, [which was] Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.

ours: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaohs hand:
theirs: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:

ours: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
theirs: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the [other] kine upon the brink of the river.

ours: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
theirs: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, [it was] a dream.

ours: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
theirs: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but [there was] none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

ours: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guards house, both me and the chief baker:
theirs: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard's house, [both] me and the chief baker:

ours: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
theirs: And [there was] there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.

ours: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
theirs: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved [himself], and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

ours: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.
theirs: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and [there is] none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, [that] thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

ours: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
theirs: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, [It is] not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

ours: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
theirs: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they [were] still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

ours: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
theirs: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, [and] blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

ours: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
theirs: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told [this] unto the magicians; but [there was] none that could declare [it] to me.

ours: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
theirs: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh [is] one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he [is] about to do.

ours: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
theirs: The seven good kine [are] seven years; and the seven good ears [are] seven years: the dream [is] one.

ours: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
theirs: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them [are] seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

ours: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
theirs: This [is] the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God [is] about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.

ours: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
theirs: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it [shall be] very grievous.

ours: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
theirs: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; [it is] because the thing [is] established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

ours: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
theirs: Let Pharaoh do [this], and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

ours: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
theirs: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find [such a one] as this [is], a man in whom the Spirit of God [is]?

ours: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:
theirs: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, [there is] none so discreet and wise as thou [art]:

ours: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Josephs hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
theirs: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

ours: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
theirs: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him [ruler] over all the land of Egypt.

ours: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
theirs: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I [am] Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

ours: And Pharaoh called Josephs name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
theirs: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over [all] the land of Egypt.

ours: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
theirs: And Joseph [was] thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

ours: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
theirs: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which [was] round about every city, laid he up in the same.

ours: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
theirs: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for [it was] without number.

ours: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
theirs: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.

ours: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my fathers house.
theirs: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, [said he], hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.

ours: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
theirs: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy [corn]; because that the famine was [so] sore in all lands.

ours: And Josephs ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
theirs: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

ours: But Benjamin, Josephs brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
theirs: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

ours: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
theirs: And the sons of Israel came to buy [corn] among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

ours: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Josephs brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.
theirs: And Joseph [was] the governor over the land, [and] he [it was] that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him [with] their faces to the earth.

ours: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
theirs: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye [are] spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

ours: We are all one mans sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
theirs: We [are] all one man's sons; we [are] true [men], thy servants are no spies.

ours: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
theirs: And they said, Thy servants [are] twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest [is] this day with our father, and one [is] not.

ours: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:
theirs: And Joseph said unto them, That [is it] that I spake unto you, saying, Ye [are] spies:

ours: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.
theirs: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether [there be any] truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye [are] spies.

ours: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:
theirs: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; [for] I fear God:

ours: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
theirs: If ye [be] true [men], let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

ours: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
theirs: And they said one to another, We [are] verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

ours: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
theirs: And they knew not that Joseph understood [them]; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.

ours: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every mans money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
theirs: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

ours: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sacks mouth.
theirs: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it [was] in his sack's mouth.

ours: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?
theirs: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, [it is] even in my sack: and their heart failed [them], and they were afraid, saying one to another, What [is] this [that] God hath done unto us?

ours: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
theirs: The man, [who is] the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

ours: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:
theirs: And we said unto him, We [are] true [men]; we are no spies:

ours: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
theirs: We [be] twelve brethren, sons of our father; one [is] not, and the youngest [is] this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

ours: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:
theirs: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye [are] true [men]; leave one of your brethren [here] with me, and take [food for] the famine of your households, and be gone:

ours: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.
theirs: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye [are] no spies, but [that] ye [are] true [men: so] will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.

ours: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every mans bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
theirs: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money [was] in his sack: and when [both] they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

ours: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.
theirs: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved [of my children]: Joseph [is] not, and Simeon [is] not, and ye will take Benjamin [away]: all these things are against me.

ours: AND the famine was sore in the land.
theirs: And the famine [was] sore in the land.

ours: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
theirs: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother [be] with you.

ours: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
theirs: But if thou wilt not send [him], we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother [be] with you.

ours: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
theirs: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye [so] ill with me, [as] to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

ours: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
theirs: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, [Is] your father yet alive? have ye [another] brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

ours: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.
theirs: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, [and] also our little ones.

ours: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
theirs: And their father Israel said unto them, If [it must be] so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

ours: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:
theirs: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry [it] again in your hand; peradventure it [was] an oversight:

ours: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.
theirs: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved [of my children], I am bereaved.

ours: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.
theirs: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring [these] men home, and slay, and make ready; for [these] men shall dine with me at noon.

ours: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Josephs house.
theirs: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.

ours: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Josephs house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
theirs: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

ours: And they came near to the steward of Josephs house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,
theirs: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

ours: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every mans money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
theirs: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, [every] man's money [was] in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

ours: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
theirs: And he said, Peace [be] to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

ours: And the man brought the men into Josephs house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
theirs: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave [them] water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

ours: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
theirs: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which [was] in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

ours: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?
theirs: And he asked them of [their] welfare, and said, [Is] your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? [Is] he yet alive?

ours: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
theirs: And they answered, Thy servant our father [is] in good health, he [is] yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

ours: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mothers son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.
theirs: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, [Is] this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

ours: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
theirs: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought [where] to weep; and he entered into [his] chamber, and wept there.

ours: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
theirs: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that [is] an abomination unto the Egyptians.

ours: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamins mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
theirs: And he took [and sent] messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

ours: AND he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the mens sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every mans money in his sacks mouth.
theirs: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks [with] food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.

ours: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sacks mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
theirs: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

ours: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
theirs: [And] when they were gone out of the city, [and] not [yet] far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

ours: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
theirs: [Is] not this [it] in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

ours: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lords house silver or gold?
theirs: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?

ours: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lords bondmen.
theirs: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.

ours: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
theirs: And he said, Now also [let] it [be] according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

ours: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamins sack.
theirs: And he searched, [and] began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

ours: And Judah and his brethren came to Josephs house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
theirs: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he [was] yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

ours: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
theirs: And Joseph said unto them, What deed [is] this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

ours: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lords servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.
theirs: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we [are] my lord's servants, both we, and [he] also with whom the cup is found.

ours: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
theirs: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: [but] the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

ours: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lords ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.
theirs: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou [art] even as Pharaoh.

ours: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
theirs: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for [if] he should leave his father, [his father] would die.

ours: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.
theirs: And our father said, Go again, [and] buy us a little food.

ours: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the mans face, except our youngest brother be with us.
theirs: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother [be] with us.

ours: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
theirs: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two [sons]:

ours: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lads life;
theirs: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad [be] not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;

ours: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
theirs: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad [is] not [with us], that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

ours: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
theirs: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad [be] not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.

ours: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
theirs: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I [am] Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

ours: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
theirs: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I [am] Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

ours: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
theirs: For these two years [hath] the famine [been] in the land: and yet [there are] five years, in the which [there shall] neither [be] earing nor harvest.

ours: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
theirs: So now [it was] not you [that] sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

ours: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy childrens children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
theirs: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

ours: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
theirs: And there will I nourish thee; for yet [there are] five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

ours: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
theirs: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that [it is] my mouth that speaketh unto you.

ours: And he fell upon his brother Benjamins neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
theirs: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

ours: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaohs house, saying, Josephs brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
theirs: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

ours: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.
theirs: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt [is] yours.

ours: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
theirs: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred [pieces] of silver, and five changes of raiment.

ours: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
theirs: And to his father he sent after this [manner]; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

ours: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacobs heart fainted, for he believed them not.
theirs: And told him, saying, Joseph [is] yet alive, and he [is] governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.

ours: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
theirs: And Israel said, [It is] enough; Joseph my son [is] yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

ours: AND Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
theirs: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

ours: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
theirs: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here [am] I.

ours: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
theirs: And he said, I [am] God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

ours: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
theirs: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up [again]: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

ours: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
theirs: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

ours: His sons, and his sons sons with him, his daughters, and his sons daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
theirs: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

ours: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacobs firstborn.
theirs: And these [are] the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.

ours: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
theirs: These [be] the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters [were] thirty and three.

ours: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
theirs: These [are] the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, [even] sixteen souls.

ours: The sons of Rachel Jacobs wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
theirs: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

ours: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.
theirs: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.

ours: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
theirs: And the sons of Benjamin [were] Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

ours: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
theirs: These [are] the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls [were] fourteen.

ours: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
theirs: These [are] the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls [were] seven.

ours: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacobs sons wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
theirs: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls [were] threescore and six;

ours: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
theirs: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, [were] two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, [were] threescore and ten.

ours: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
theirs: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou [art] yet alive.

ours: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his fathers house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my fathers house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
theirs: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which [were] in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

ours: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
theirs: And the men [are] shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

ours: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
theirs: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What [is] your occupation?

ours: That ye shall say, Thy servants trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
theirs: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, [and] also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd [is] an abomination unto the Egyptians.

ours: THEN Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
theirs: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they [are] in the land of Goshen.

ours: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
theirs: And he took some of his brethren, [even] five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

ours: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.
theirs: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What [is] your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants [are] shepherds, both we, [and] also our fathers.

ours: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
theirs: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine [is] sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

ours: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
theirs: The land of Egypt [is] before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest [any] men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

ours: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?
theirs: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old [art] thou?

ours: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
theirs: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage [are] an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

ours: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his fathers household, with bread, according to their families.
theirs: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to [their] families.

ours: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
theirs: And [there was] no bread in all the land; for the famine [was] very sore, so that the land of Egypt and [all] the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

ours: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaohs house.
theirs: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

ours: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
theirs: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread [in exchange] for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

ours: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
theirs: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide [it] from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

ours: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
theirs: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give [us] seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

ours: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaohs.
theirs: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.

ours: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
theirs: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from [one] end of the borders of Egypt even to the [other] end thereof.

ours: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
theirs: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion [assigned them] of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

ours: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
theirs: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, [here is] seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

ours: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
theirs: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth [part] unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

ours: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaohs servants.
theirs: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.

ours: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaohs.
theirs: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, [that] Pharaoh should have the fifth [part]; except the land of the priests only, [which] became not Pharaoh's.

ours: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the beds head.
theirs: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.

ours: AND it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
theirs: And it came to pass after these things, that [one] told Joseph, Behold, thy father [is] sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

ours: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
theirs: And [one] told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

ours: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
theirs: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee [for] an everlasting possession.

ours: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
theirs: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, [are] mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

ours: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
theirs: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, [and] shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

ours: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Beth-lehem.
theirs: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet [there was] but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same [is] Bethlehem.

ours: And Israel beheld Josephs sons, and said, Who are these?
theirs: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who [are] these?

ours: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
theirs: And Joseph said unto his father, They [are] my sons, whom God hath given me in this [place]. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

ours: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
theirs: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, [so that] he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

ours: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israels left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israels right hand, and brought them near unto him.
theirs: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought [them] near unto him.
