ours: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
theirs: Now these [are] the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before [any] king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city [was] Dinhabah.

ours: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
theirs: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city [was] Avith.

ours: And when Shaul was dead, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
theirs: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

ours: And when Baal-hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wifes name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
theirs: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city [was] Pai; and his wife's name [was] Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

ours: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
theirs: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These [are] the dukes of Edom.

ours: THESE are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
theirs: These [are] the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

ours: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
theirs: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: [which] three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.

ours: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
theirs: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah [were] five.

ours: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
theirs: Whose sisters [were] Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

ours: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
theirs: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa [was] Jether the Ishmeelite.

ours: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
theirs: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat [children] of Azubah [his] wife, and of Jerioth: her sons [are] these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

ours: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
theirs: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he [was] threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

ours: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
theirs: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, [even] threescore cities. All these [belonged to] the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

ours: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezrons wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
theirs: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.

ours: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
theirs: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, [and] Ahijah.

ours: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
theirs: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name [was] Atarah; she [was] the mother of Onam.

ours: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
theirs: And the name of the wife of Abishur [was] Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

ours: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
theirs: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name [was] Jarha.

ours: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
theirs: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel [were], Mesha his firstborn, which [was] the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

ours: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
theirs: And the son of Shammai [was] Maon: and Maon [was] the father of Bethzur.

ours: And Ephah, Calebs concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
theirs: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.

ours: Maachah, Calebs concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
theirs: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.

ours: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
theirs: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb [was] Achsah.

ours: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,
theirs: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim,

ours: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
theirs: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.

ours: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
theirs: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, [and] half of the Manahethites.

ours: And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
theirs: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.

ours: The sons of Salma; Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
theirs: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

ours: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
theirs: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, [and] Suchathites. These [are] the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

ours: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
theirs: [These] six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

ours: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:
theirs: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:

ours: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
theirs: [These were] all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

ours: And Solomons son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
theirs: And Solomon's son [was] Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

ours: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
theirs: And the sons of Josiah [were], the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

ours: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
theirs: And the sons of Pedaiah [were], Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:

ours: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.
theirs: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.

ours: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
theirs: And the sons of Elioenai [were], Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.

ours: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
theirs: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These [are] the families of the Zorathites.

ours: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
theirs: And these [were of] the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister [was] Hazelelponi:

ours: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Beth-lehem.
theirs: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These [are] the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.

ours: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
theirs: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These [were] the sons of Naarah.

ours: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
theirs: And the sons of Helah [were], Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.

ours: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
theirs: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep [me] from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

ours: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
theirs: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which [was] the father of Eshton.

ours: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Rechah.
theirs: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These [are] the men of Rechah.

ours: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
theirs: And the sons of Ezra [were], Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

ours: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
theirs: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these [are] the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.

ours: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
theirs: And the sons of [his] wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

ours: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.
theirs: And the sons of Shimon [were], Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi [were], Zoheth, and Benzoheth.

ours: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
theirs: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah [were], Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,

ours: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.
theirs: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And [these are] ancient things.

ours: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
theirs: These [were] the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

ours: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
theirs: The sons of Simeon [were], Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, [and] Shaul:

ours: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,
theirs: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,

ours: And at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
theirs: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These [were] their cities unto the reign of David.

ours: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
theirs: And their villages [were], Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:

ours: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
theirs: And all their villages that [were] round about the same cities, unto Baal. These [were] their habitations, and their genealogy.

ours: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
theirs: These mentioned by [their] names [were] princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.

ours: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
theirs: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, [even] unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

ours: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
theirs: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land [was] wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for [they] of Ham had dwelt there of old.

ours: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
theirs: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because [there was] pasture there for their flocks.

ours: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
theirs: And [some] of them, [even] of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

ours: NOW the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his fathers bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
theirs: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he [was] the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

ours: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Josephs:)
theirs: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him [came] the chief ruler; but the birthright [was] Joseph's:)

ours: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
theirs: The sons, [I say], of Reuben the firstborn of Israel [were], Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

ours: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
theirs: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away [captive]: he [was] prince of the Reubenites.

ours: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
theirs: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, [were] the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

ours: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:
theirs: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:

ours: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.
theirs: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east [land] of Gilead.

ours: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
theirs: And their brethren of the house of their fathers [were], Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

ours: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
theirs: These [are] the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

ours: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.
theirs: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, [were] four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.

ours: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
theirs: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that [were] with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

ours: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
theirs: For there fell down many slain, because the war [was] of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

ours: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
theirs: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.

ours: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.
theirs: And these [were] the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, [and] heads of the house of their fathers.

ours: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
theirs: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

ours: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priests office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
theirs: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he [it is] that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)

ours: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
theirs: And Jehozadak went [into captivity], when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

ours: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
theirs: And these [be] the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.

ours: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
theirs: And the sons of Kohath [were], Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

ours: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
theirs: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these [are] the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

ours: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
theirs: [As for] Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

ours: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
theirs: And these [are they] whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.

ours: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
theirs: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and [then] they waited on their office according to their order.

ours: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
theirs: And these [are] they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,

ours: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
theirs: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, [even] Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

ours: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
theirs: And their brethren the sons of Merari [stood] on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

ours: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
theirs: Their brethren also the Levites [were] appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

ours: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
theirs: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, [and were appointed] for all the work of the [place] most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

ours: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
theirs: And these [are] the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

ours: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
theirs: Now these [are] their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.

ours: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
theirs: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, [namely], Hebron, [the city] of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,

ours: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs:
theirs: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:

ours: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
theirs: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families [were] thirteen cities.

ours: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
theirs: And unto the sons of Kohath, [which were] left of the family of that tribe, [were cities given] out of the half tribe, [namely, out of] the half [tribe] of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

ours: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
theirs: Unto the sons of Merari [were given] by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

ours: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
theirs: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites [these] cities with their suburbs.

ours: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
theirs: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by [their] names.

ours: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
theirs: And [the residue] of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.

ours: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
theirs: And they gave unto them, [of] the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; [they gave] also Gezer with her suburbs,

ours: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs,
theirs: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,

ours: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs:
theirs: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:

ours: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
theirs: Unto the sons of Gershom [were given] out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:

ours: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
theirs: Unto the rest of the children of Merari [were given] out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:

ours: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
theirs: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, [were given them] out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,

ours: NOW the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
theirs: Now the sons of Issachar [were], Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

ours: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
theirs: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, [to wit], of Tola: [they were] valiant men of might in their generations; whose number [was] in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

ours: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
theirs: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, [were] bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand [men]: for they had many wives and sons.

ours: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
theirs: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar [were] valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.

ours: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
theirs: [The sons] of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

ours: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
theirs: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of [their] fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

ours: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
theirs: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these [are] the sons of Becher.

ours: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
theirs: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, [was] twenty thousand and two hundred.

ours: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
theirs: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, [were] seventeen thousand and two hundred [soldiers], fit to go out for war [and] battle.

ours: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
theirs: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, [and] Hushim, the sons of Aher.

ours: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
theirs: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: ([but] his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:

ours: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sisters name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
theirs: And Machir took to wife [the sister] of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name [was] Maachah;) and the name of the second [was] Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

ours: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
theirs: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother [was] Sheresh; and his sons [were] Ulam and Rakem.

ours: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
theirs: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These [were] the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

ours: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
theirs: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath [that were] born in [that] land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

ours: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Beth-horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.)
theirs: (And his daughter [was] Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)

ours: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
theirs: And Rephah [was] his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

ours: And their possessions and habitations were, Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
theirs: And their possessions and habitations [were], Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:

ours: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
theirs: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.

ours: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
theirs: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who [is] the father of Birzavith.

ours: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
theirs: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These [are] the children of Japhlet.

ours: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their fathers house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
theirs: All these [were] the children of Asher, heads of [their] father's house, choice [and] mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war [and] to battle [was] twenty and six thousand men.

ours: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
theirs: And these [are] the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:

ours: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
theirs: And Shaharaim begat [children] in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara [were] his wives.

ours: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
theirs: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These [were] his sons, heads of the fathers.

ours: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
theirs: Beriah also, and Shema, who [were] heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:

ours: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
theirs: These [were] heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief [men]. These dwelt in Jerusalem.

ours: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wifes name was Maachah:
theirs: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name [was] Maachah:

ours: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
theirs: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

ours: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.
theirs: And the son of Jonathan [was] Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.

ours: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
theirs: And the sons of Micah [were], Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

ours: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
theirs: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha [was] his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:

ours: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
theirs: And Azel had six sons, whose names [are] these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these [were] the sons of Azel.

ours: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
theirs: And the sons of Eshek his brother [were], Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

ours: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
theirs: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these [are] of the sons of Benjamin.

ours: SO all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
theirs: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they [were] written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, [who] were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.

ours: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
theirs: Now the first inhabitants that [dwelt] in their possessions in their cities [were], the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.

ours: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
theirs: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men [were] chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.

ours: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;
theirs: And the porters [were], Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum [was] the chief;

ours: Who hitherto waited in the kings gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
theirs: Who hitherto [waited] in the king's gate eastward: they [were] porters in the companies of the children of Levi.

ours: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the LORD, were keepers of the entry.
theirs: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, [were] over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, [being] over the host of the LORD, [were] keepers of the entry.

ours: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.
theirs: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, [and] the LORD [was] with him.

ours: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
theirs: [And] Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah [was] porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

ours: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
theirs: All these [which were] chosen to be porters in the gates [were] two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.

ours: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
theirs: So they and their children [had] the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, [namely], the house of the tabernacle, by wards.

ours: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
theirs: And their brethren, [which were] in their villages, [were] to come after seven days from time to time with them.

ours: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
theirs: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in [their] set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

ours: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
theirs: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge [was] upon them, and the opening thereof every morning [pertained] to them.

ours: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
theirs: And [certain] of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.

ours: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
theirs: [Some] of them also [were] appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

ours: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
theirs: And [some] of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

ours: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
theirs: And Mattithiah, [one] of the Levites, who [was] the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

ours: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
theirs: And [other] of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, [were] over the shewbread, to prepare [it] every sabbath.

ours: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
theirs: And these [are] the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, [who remaining] in the chambers [were] free: for they were employed in [that] work day and night.

ours: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
theirs: These chief fathers of the Levites [were] chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.

ours: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wifes name was Maachah:
theirs: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name [was] Maachah:

ours: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
theirs: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

ours: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal: and Merib-baal begat Micah.
theirs: And the son of Jonathan [was] Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.

ours: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
theirs: And the sons of Micah [were], Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, [and Ahaz].

ours: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
theirs: And Azel had six sons, whose names [are] these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these [were] the sons of Azel.

ours: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
theirs: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

ours: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
theirs: And when all the men of Israel that [were] in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

ours: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
theirs: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

ours: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, even against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to inquire of it;
theirs: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, [even] against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking [counsel] of [one that had] a familiar spirit, to inquire [of it];

ours: THEN all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
theirs: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we [are] thy bone and thy flesh.

ours: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
theirs: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou [wast] he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.

ours: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
theirs: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which [is] Jebus; where the Jebusites [were], the inhabitants of the land.

ours: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
theirs: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which [is] the city of David.

ours: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him.
theirs: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts [was] with him.

ours: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
theirs: These also [are] the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, [and] with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.

ours: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
theirs: And this [is] the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain [by him] at one time.

ours: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
theirs: And after him [was] Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who [was one] of the three mighties.

ours: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
theirs: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

ours: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.
theirs: And they set themselves in the midst of [that] parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved [them] by a great deliverance.

ours: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines garrison was then at Beth-lehem.
theirs: And David [was] then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison [was] then at Bethlehem.

ours: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, that is at the gate!
theirs: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that [is] at the gate!

ours: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
theirs: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that [was] by the gate, and took [it], and brought [it] to David: but David would not drink [of] it, but poured it out to the LORD,

ours: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
theirs: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with [the jeopardy of] their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

ours: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
theirs: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew [them], and had a name among the three.

ours: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
theirs: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the [first] three.

ours: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptians hand was a spear like a weavers beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptians hand, and slew him with his own spear.
theirs: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of [great] stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand [was] a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

ours: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
theirs: These [things] did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.

ours: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
theirs: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the [first] three: and David set him over his guard.

ours: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,
theirs: Also the valiant men of the armies [were], Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

ours: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-ezer the Antothite,
theirs: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,

ours: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
theirs: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, [that pertained] to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

ours: NOW these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
theirs: Now these [are] they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they [were] among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

ours: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Sauls brethren of Benjamin.
theirs: [They were] armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in [hurling] stones and [shooting] arrows out of a bow, [even] of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.

ours: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
theirs: The chief [was] Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,

ours: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
theirs: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, [and] men of war [fit] for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces [were like] the faces of lions, and [were] as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

ours: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
theirs: These [were] of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least [was] over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

ours: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
theirs: These [are] they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all [them] of the valleys, [both] toward the east, and toward the west.

ours: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
theirs: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if [ye be come] to betray me to mine enemies, seeing [there is] no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look [thereon], and rebuke [it].

ours: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
theirs: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, [who was] chief of the captains, [and he said], Thine [are we], David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace [be] unto thee, and peace [be] to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

ours: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
theirs: And there fell [some] of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to [the jeopardy of] our heads.

ours: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
theirs: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that [were] of Manasseh.

ours: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
theirs: And they helped David against the band [of the rovers]: for they [were] all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

ours: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
theirs: For at [that] time day by day there came to David to help him, until [it was] a great host, like the host of God.

ours: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.
theirs: And these [are] the numbers of the bands [that were] ready armed to the war, [and] came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.

ours: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
theirs: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear [were] six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

ours: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
theirs: And Jehoiada [was] the leader of the Aaronites, and with him [were] three thousand and seven hundred;

ours: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his fathers house twenty and two captains.
theirs: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.

ours: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
theirs: And of the children of Issachar, [which were men] that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them [were] two hundred; and all their brethren [were] at their commandment.

ours: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
theirs: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: [they were] not of double heart.

ours: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
theirs: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel [were] of one heart to make David king.

ours: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.
theirs: Moreover they that were nigh them, [even] unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, [and] meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for [there was] joy in Israel.

ours: AND David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
theirs: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, [and] with every leader.

ours: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
theirs: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If [it seem] good unto you, and [that it be] of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, [that are] left in all the land of Israel, and with them [also] to the priests and Levites [which are] in their cities [and] suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

ours: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.
theirs: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.

ours: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
theirs: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, [that is], to Kirjathjearim, which [belonged] to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth [between] the cherubims, whose name is called [on it].

ours: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
theirs: And David and all Israel played before God with all [their] might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

ours: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.
theirs: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day.

ours: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
theirs: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God [home] to me?

ours: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
theirs: So David brought not the ark [home] to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.

ours: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.
theirs: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.

ours: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
theirs: Now these [are] the names of [his] children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

ours: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
theirs: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard [of it], and went out against them.

ours: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
theirs: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.

ours: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
theirs: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, [that] then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

ours: AND David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
theirs: And [David] made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

ours: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.
theirs: And said unto them, Ye [are] the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, [both] ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto [the place that] I have prepared for it.

ours: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
theirs: For because ye [did it] not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

ours: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
theirs: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren [to be] the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

ours: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.
theirs: And with them their brethren of the second [degree], Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.

ours: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
theirs: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, [were appointed] to sound with cymbals of brass;

ours: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
theirs: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

ours: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
theirs: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, [was] for song: he instructed about the song, because he [was] skilful.

ours: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
theirs: And Berechiah and Elkanah [were] doorkeepers for the ark.

ours: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
theirs: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah [were] doorkeepers for the ark.

ours: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.
theirs: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obededom with joy.

ours: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
theirs: And David [was] clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also [had] upon him an ephod of linen.

ours: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
theirs: And it came to pass, [as] the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

ours: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.
theirs: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon [of wine].

ours: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:
theirs: And he appointed [certain] of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:

ours: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
theirs: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

ours: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
theirs: Then on that day David delivered first [this psalm] to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

ours: He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
theirs: He [is] the LORD our God; his judgments [are] in all the earth.

ours: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
theirs: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word [which] he commanded to a thousand generations;

ours: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
theirs: [Even of the covenant] which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

ours: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
theirs: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, [and] to Israel [for] an everlasting covenant,

ours: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
theirs: And [when] they went from nation to nation, and from [one] kingdom to another people;

ours: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
theirs: [Saying], Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

ours: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
theirs: For great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also [is] to be feared above all gods.

ours: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
theirs: For all the gods of the people [are] idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

ours: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
theirs: Glory and honour [are] in his presence; strength and gladness [are] in his place.

ours: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
theirs: Give unto the LORD the glory [due] unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

ours: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
theirs: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let [men] say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.

ours: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
theirs: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that [is] therein.

ours: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: O give thanks unto the LORD; for [he is] good; for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.
theirs: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, [and] glory in thy praise.

ours: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.
theirs: Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.

ours: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every days work required:
theirs: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:

ours: And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:
theirs: And Obededom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah [to be] porters:

ours: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon,
theirs: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that [was] at Gibeon,

ours: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;
theirs: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and [to do] according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;

ours: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever;
theirs: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy [endureth] for ever;

ours: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.
theirs: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun [were] porters.

ours: NOW it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains.
theirs: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD [remaineth] under curtains.

ours: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.
theirs: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that [is] in thine heart; for God [is] with thee.

ours: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
theirs: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from [one] tabernacle [to another].

ours: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
theirs: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, [even] from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

ours: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.
theirs: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that [are] in the earth.

ours: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.
theirs: And since the time that I commanded judges [to be] over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.

ours: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
theirs: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go [to be] with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

ours: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:
theirs: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took [it] from [him] that was before thee:

ours: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who am I, O LORD God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
theirs: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who [am] I, O LORD God, and what [is] mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
