ours: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
theirs: Oh that [men] would praise the LORD [for] his goodness, and [for] his wonderful works to the children of men!

ours: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
theirs: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, [being] bound in affliction and iron;

ours: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
theirs: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and [there was] none to help.

ours: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
theirs: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, [and] he saved them out of their distresses.

ours: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
theirs: Oh that [men] would praise the LORD [for] his goodness, and [for] his wonderful works to the children of men!

ours: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
theirs: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, [and] he saveth them out of their distresses.

ours: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
theirs: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered [them] from their destructions.

ours: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
theirs: Oh that [men] would praise the LORD [for] his goodness, and [for] his wonderful works to the children of men!

ours: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits end.
theirs: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.

ours: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
theirs: Oh that [men] would praise the LORD [for] his goodness, and [for] his wonderful works to the children of men!

ours: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
theirs: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, [where there is] no way.

ours: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
theirs: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh [him] families like a flock.

ours: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
theirs: The righteous shall see [it], and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

ours: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
theirs: Whoso [is] wise, and will observe these [things], even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.

ours: O GOD, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
theirs: <<A Song [or] Psalm of David.>> O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

ours: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
theirs: Awake, psaltery and harp: I [myself] will awake early.

ours: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
theirs: For thy mercy [is] great above the heavens: and thy truth [reacheth] unto the clouds.

ours: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
theirs: That thy beloved may be delivered: save [with] thy right hand, and answer me.

ours: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
theirs: Gilead [is] mine; Manasseh [is] mine; Ephraim also [is] the strength of mine head; Judah [is] my lawgiver;

ours: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
theirs: Moab [is] my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

ours: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
theirs: [Wilt] not [thou], O God, [who] hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

ours: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
theirs: Give us help from trouble: for vain [is] the help of man.

ours: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
theirs: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he [it is that] shall tread down our enemies.

ours: HOLD not thy peace, O God of my praise;
theirs: <<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

ours: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
theirs: For my love they are my adversaries: but I [give myself unto] prayer.

ours: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
theirs: Let his days be few; [and] let another take his office.

ours: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
theirs: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek [their bread] also out of their desolate places.

ours: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
theirs: Let his posterity be cut off; [and] in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

ours: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
theirs: Let it be unto him as the garment [which] covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

ours: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
theirs: [Let] this [be] the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

ours: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy names sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
theirs: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy [is] good, deliver thou me.

ours: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
theirs: For I [am] poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

ours: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
theirs: I became also a reproach unto them: [when] they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

ours: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
theirs: That they may know that this [is] thy hand; [that] thou, LORD, hast done it.

ours: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
theirs: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save [him] from those that condemn his soul.

ours: THE LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
theirs: <<A Psalm of David.>> The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

ours: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
theirs: Thy people [shall be] willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

ours: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
theirs: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou [art] a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

ours: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
theirs: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill [the places] with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

ours: PRAISE ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
theirs: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with [my] whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and [in] the congregation.

ours: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
theirs: The works of the LORD [are] great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

ours: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
theirs: His work [is] honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

ours: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
theirs: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD [is] gracious and full of compassion.

ours: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
theirs: The works of his hands [are] verity and judgment; all his commandments [are] sure.

ours: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
theirs: They stand fast for ever and ever, [and are] done in truth and uprightness.

ours: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
theirs: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend [is] his name.

ours: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
theirs: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do [his commandments]: his praise endureth for ever.

ours: PRAISE ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
theirs: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed [is] the man [that] feareth the LORD, [that] delighteth greatly in his commandments.

ours: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
theirs: Wealth and riches [shall be] in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

ours: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
theirs: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: [he is] gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

ours: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
theirs: His heart [is] established, he shall not be afraid, until he see [his desire] upon his enemies.

ours: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
theirs: The wicked shall see [it], and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

ours: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORDs name is to be praised.
theirs: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD's name [is] to be praised.

ours: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
theirs: The LORD [is] high above all nations, [and] his glory above the heavens.

ours: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
theirs: Who [is] like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

ours: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
theirs: Who humbleth [himself] to behold [the things that are] in heaven, and in the earth!

ours: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
theirs: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, [and] lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

ours: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
theirs: That he may set [him] with princes, [even] with the princes of his people.

ours: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
theirs: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, [and to be] a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.

ours: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
theirs: Judah was his sanctuary, [and] Israel his dominion.

ours: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
theirs: The sea saw [it], and fled: Jordan was driven back.

ours: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
theirs: The mountains skipped like rams, [and] the little hills like lambs.

ours: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
theirs: What [ailed] thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, [that] thou wast driven back?

ours: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
theirs: Ye mountains, [that] ye skipped like rams; [and] ye little hills, like lambs?

ours: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
theirs: Which turned the rock [into] a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

ours: NOT unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truths sake.
theirs: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, [and] for thy truth's sake.

ours: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
theirs: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where [is] now their God?

ours: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
theirs: But our God [is] in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

ours: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of mens hands.
theirs: Their idols [are] silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

ours: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
theirs: They that make them are like unto them; [so is] every one that trusteth in them.

ours: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
theirs: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.

ours: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
theirs: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.

ours: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
theirs: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.

ours: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
theirs: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless [us]; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

ours: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.
theirs: He will bless them that fear the LORD, [both] small and great.

ours: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
theirs: Ye [are] blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.

ours: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORDs: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
theirs: The heaven, [even] the heavens, [are] the LORD's: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

ours: I LOVE the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
theirs: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice [and] my supplications.

ours: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
theirs: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon [him] as long as I live.

ours: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
theirs: Gracious [is] the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God [is] merciful.

ours: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
theirs: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, [and] my feet from falling.

ours: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
theirs: I said in my haste, All men [are] liars.

ours: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
theirs: What shall I render unto the LORD [for] all his benefits toward me?

ours: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
theirs: Precious in the sight of the LORD [is] the death of his saints.

ours: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
theirs: O LORD, truly I [am] thy servant; I [am] thy servant, [and] the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

ours: In the courts of the LORDs house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
theirs: In the courts of the LORD's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.

ours: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
theirs: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD [endureth] for ever. Praise ye the LORD.

ours: O GIVE thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: O give thanks unto the LORD; for [he is] good: because his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: Let Israel now say, that his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
theirs: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, [and set me] in a large place.

ours: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
theirs: The LORD [is] on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

ours: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
theirs: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see [my desire] upon them that hate me.

ours: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
theirs: [It is] better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.

ours: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
theirs: [It is] better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.

ours: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
theirs: The LORD [is] my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

ours: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
theirs: The voice of rejoicing and salvation [is] in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

ours: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:
theirs: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, [and] I will praise the LORD:

ours: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
theirs: The stone [which] the builders refused is become the head [stone] of the corner.

ours: This is the LORDs doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
theirs: This is the LORD's doing; it [is] marvellous in our eyes.

ours: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
theirs: This [is] the day [which] the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

ours: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
theirs: Blessed [be] he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.

ours: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
theirs: God [is] the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, [even] unto the horns of the altar.

ours: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
theirs: Thou [art] my God, and I will praise thee: [thou art] my God, I will exalt thee.

ours: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: O give thanks unto the LORD; for [he is] good: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: BLESSED are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
theirs: ALEPH. Blessed [are] the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.

ours: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
theirs: Blessed [are] they that keep his testimonies, [and that] seek him with the whole heart.

ours: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
theirs: Thou hast commanded [us] to keep thy precepts diligently.

ours: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
theirs: BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed [thereto] according to thy word.

ours: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
theirs: Blessed [art] thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.

ours: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
theirs: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as [much as] in all riches.

ours: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
theirs: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, [that] I may live, and keep thy word.

ours: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
theirs: I [am] a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

ours: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
theirs: My soul breaketh for the longing [that it hath] unto thy judgments at all times.

ours: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
theirs: Thou hast rebuked the proud [that are] cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

ours: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
theirs: Princes also did sit [and] speak against me: [but] thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

ours: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellers.
theirs: Thy testimonies also [are] my delight [and] my counsellers.

ours: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
theirs: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

ours: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
theirs: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid [before me].

ours: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
theirs: HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it [unto] the end.

ours: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
theirs: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with [my] whole heart.

ours: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
theirs: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; [and] quicken thou me in thy way.

ours: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
theirs: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who [is devoted] to thy fear.

ours: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
theirs: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments [are] good.

ours: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
theirs: VAU. Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, [even] thy salvation, according to thy word.

ours: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
theirs: ZAIN. Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

ours: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
theirs: This [is] my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

ours: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
theirs: The proud have had me greatly in derision: [yet] have I not declined from thy law.

ours: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
theirs: CHETH. [Thou art] my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.

ours: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
theirs: I intreated thy favour with [my] whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

ours: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
theirs: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: [but] I have not forgotten thy law.

ours: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
theirs: I [am] a companion of all [them] that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

ours: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
theirs: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.

ours: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
theirs: Thou [art] good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

ours: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
theirs: The proud have forged a lie against me: [but] I will keep thy precepts with [my] whole heart.

ours: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
theirs: Their heart is as fat as grease; [but] I delight in thy law.

ours: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
theirs: [It is] good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

ours: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
theirs: The law of thy mouth [is] better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

ours: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
theirs: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

ours: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
theirs: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments [are] right, and [that] thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

ours: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
theirs: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law [is] my delight.

ours: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
theirs: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: [but] I will meditate in thy precepts.

ours: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
theirs: CAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation: [but] I hope in thy word.

ours: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
theirs: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; [yet] do I not forget thy statutes.

ours: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
theirs: How many [are] the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

ours: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
theirs: The proud have digged pits for me, which [are] not after thy law.

ours: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
theirs: All thy commandments [are] faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

ours: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
theirs: LAMED. For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.

ours: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
theirs: Thy faithfulness [is] unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

ours: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
theirs: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all [are] thy servants.

ours: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
theirs: Unless thy law [had been] my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

ours: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
theirs: I [am] thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

ours: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
theirs: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: [but] I will consider thy testimonies.

ours: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
theirs: I have seen an end of all perfection: [but] thy commandment [is] exceeding broad.

ours: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
theirs: MEM. O how love I thy law! it [is] my meditation all the day.

ours: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
theirs: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they [are] ever with me.

ours: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
theirs: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies [are] my meditation.

ours: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
theirs: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! [yea, sweeter] than honey to my mouth!

ours: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
theirs: NUN. Thy word [is] a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

ours: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
theirs: I have sworn, and I will perform [it], that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

ours: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
theirs: My soul [is] continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

ours: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
theirs: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they [are] the rejoicing of my heart.

ours: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
theirs: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, [even unto] the end.

ours: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
theirs: SAMECH. I hate [vain] thoughts: but thy law do I love.

ours: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
theirs: Thou [art] my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

ours: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
theirs: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit [is] falsehood.

ours: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
theirs: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth [like] dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

ours: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
theirs: AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

ours: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
theirs: I [am] thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

ours: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
theirs: [It is] time for [thee], LORD, to work: [for] they have made void thy law.

ours: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
theirs: Therefore I esteem all [thy] precepts [concerning] all [things to be] right; [and] I hate every false way.

ours: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
theirs: PE. Thy testimonies [are] wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

ours: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
theirs: TZADDI. Righteous [art] thou, O LORD, and upright [are] thy judgments.

ours: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
theirs: Thy testimonies [that] thou hast commanded [are] righteous and very faithful.

ours: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
theirs: Thy word [is] very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

ours: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
theirs: I [am] small and despised: [yet] do not I forget thy precepts.

ours: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
theirs: Thy righteousness [is] an everlasting righteousness, and thy law [is] the truth.

ours: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
theirs: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: [yet] thy commandments [are] my delights.

ours: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
theirs: The righteousness of thy testimonies [is] everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

ours: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
theirs: KOPH. I cried with [my] whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.

ours: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
theirs: Mine eyes prevent the [night] watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

ours: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
theirs: Thou [art] near, O LORD; and all thy commandments [are] truth.

ours: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
theirs: RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

ours: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
theirs: Salvation [is] far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

ours: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
theirs: Great [are] thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.

ours: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
theirs: Many [are] my persecutors and mine enemies; [yet] do I not decline from thy testimonies.

ours: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
theirs: Thy word [is] true [from] the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments [endureth] for ever.

ours: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
theirs: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

ours: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
theirs: I hate and abhor lying: [but] thy law do I love.

ours: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
theirs: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways [are] before thee.

ours: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
theirs: TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.

ours: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
theirs: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments [are] righteousness.

ours: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
theirs: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law [is] my delight.

ours: IN my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
theirs: <<A Song of degrees.>> In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.

ours: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
theirs: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, [and] from a deceitful tongue.

ours: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
theirs: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, [that] I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

ours: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
theirs: I [am for] peace: but when I speak, they [are] for war.

ours: I WILL lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
theirs: <<A Song of degrees.>> I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

ours: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
theirs: My help [cometh] from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

ours: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
theirs: The LORD [is] thy keeper: the LORD [is] thy shade upon thy right hand.

ours: I WAS glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
theirs: <<A Song of degrees of David.>> I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

ours: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
theirs: Peace be within thy walls, [and] prosperity within thy palaces.

ours: For my brethren and companions sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
theirs: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace [be] within thee.

ours: UNTO thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
theirs: <<A Song of degrees.>> Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

ours: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
theirs: Behold, as the eyes of servants [look] unto the hand of their masters, [and] as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes [wait] upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

ours: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
theirs: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, [and] with the contempt of the proud.

ours: IF it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
theirs: <<A Song of degrees of David.>> If [it had] not [been] the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;

ours: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
theirs: If [it had] not [been] the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

ours: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
theirs: Blessed [be] the LORD, who hath not given us [as] a prey to their teeth.

ours: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
theirs: Our help [is] in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

ours: THEY that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
theirs: <<A Song of degrees.>> They that trust in the LORD [shall be] as mount Zion, [which] cannot be removed, [but] abideth for ever.

ours: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
theirs: [As] the mountains [are] round about Jerusalem, so the LORD [is] round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

ours: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
theirs: Do good, O LORD, unto [those that be] good, and to [them that are] upright in their hearts.

ours: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
theirs: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: [but] peace [shall be] upon Israel.

ours: WHEN the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
theirs: <<A Song of degrees.>> When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

ours: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
theirs: The LORD hath done great things for us; [whereof] we are glad.

ours: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
theirs: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves [with him].

ours: EXCEPT the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
theirs: <<A Song of degrees for Solomon.>> Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh [but] in vain.

ours: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
theirs: [It is] vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: [for] so he giveth his beloved sleep.

ours: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
theirs: Lo, children [are] an heritage of the LORD: [and] the fruit of the womb [is his] reward.

ours: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
theirs: As arrows [are] in the hand of a mighty man; so [are] children of the youth.

ours: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
theirs: Happy [is] the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

ours: BLESSED is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
theirs: <<A Song of degrees.>> Blessed [is] every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.

ours: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
theirs: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy [shalt] thou [be], and [it shall be] well with thee.

ours: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
theirs: Thy wife [shall be] as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

ours: Yea, thou shalt see thy childrens children, and peace upon Israel.
theirs: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, [and] peace upon Israel.

ours: MANY a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
theirs: <<A Song of degrees.>> Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

ours: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
theirs: The LORD [is] righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

ours: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
theirs: Let them be as the grass [upon] the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

ours: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
theirs: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD [be] upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.

ours: OUT of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
theirs: <<A Song of degrees.>> Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.

ours: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
theirs: But [there is] forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

ours: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
theirs: My soul [waiteth] for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: [I say, more than] they that watch for the morning.

ours: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
theirs: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD [there is] mercy, and with him [is] plenteous redemption.

ours: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
theirs: <<A Song of degrees of David.>> LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

ours: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
theirs: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul [is] even as a weaned child.

ours: LORD, remember David, and all his afflictions:
theirs: <<A Song of degrees.>> LORD, remember David, [and] all his afflictions:

ours: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
theirs: How he sware unto the LORD, [and] vowed unto the mighty [God] of Jacob;

ours: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
theirs: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, [or] slumber to mine eyelids,

ours: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
theirs: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty [God] of Jacob.

ours: For thy servant Davids sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
theirs: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

ours: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
theirs: The LORD hath sworn [in] truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

ours: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
theirs: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired [it] for his habitation.

ours: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
theirs: This [is] my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

ours: BEHOLD, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
theirs: <<A Song of degrees of David.>> Behold, how good and how pleasant [it is] for brethren to dwell together in unity!

ours: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aarons beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
theirs: [It is] like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, [even] Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

ours: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
theirs: As the dew of Hermon, [and as the dew] that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, [even] life for evermore.

ours: BEHOLD, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
theirs: <<A Song of degrees.>> Behold, bless ye the LORD, all [ye] servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.

ours: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
theirs: Lift up your hands [in] the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.

ours: PRAISE ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.
theirs: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise [him], O ye servants of the LORD.

ours: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
theirs: Praise the LORD; for the LORD [is] good: sing praises unto his name; for [it is] pleasant.

ours: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
theirs: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, [and] Israel for his peculiar treasure.

ours: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
theirs: For I know that the LORD [is] great, and [that] our Lord [is] above all gods.

ours: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
theirs: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, [that] did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

ours: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
theirs: [Who] sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

ours: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
theirs: And gave their land [for] an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

ours: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
theirs: Thy name, O LORD, [endureth] for ever; [and] thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.

ours: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of mens hands.
theirs: The idols of the heathen [are] silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

ours: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
theirs: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there [any] breath in their mouths.

ours: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
theirs: They that make them are like unto them: [so is] every one that trusteth in them.

ours: O GIVE thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: O give thanks unto the LORD; for [he is] good: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: To him that made great lights: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: And slew famous kings: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: [Even] an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
theirs: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy [endureth] for ever:

ours: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
theirs: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.

ours: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
theirs: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us [required of us] mirth, [saying], Sing us [one] of the songs of Zion.

ours: How shall we sing the LORDs song in a strange land?
theirs: How shall we sing the LORD's song in a strange land?

ours: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
theirs: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget [her cunning].

ours: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
theirs: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase [it], rase [it, even] to the foundation thereof.

ours: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
theirs: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy [shall he be], that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

ours: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
theirs: Happy [shall he be], that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

ours: I WILL praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
theirs: <<[A Psalm] of David.>> I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

ours: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
theirs: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, [and] strengthenedst me [with] strength in my soul.

ours: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.
theirs: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great [is] the glory of the LORD.

ours: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
theirs: Though the LORD [be] high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

ours: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
theirs: The LORD will perfect [that which] concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, [endureth] for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

ours: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
theirs: <<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known [me].

ours: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
theirs: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted [with] all my ways.

ours: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
theirs: For [there is] not a word in my tongue, [but], lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.

ours: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
theirs: [Such] knowledge [is] too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot [attain] unto it.

ours: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
theirs: If I ascend up into heaven, thou [art] there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou [art there].

ours: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
theirs: [If] I take the wings of the morning, [and] dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

ours: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
theirs: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light [are] both alike [to thee].

ours: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mothers womb.
theirs: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.

ours: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
theirs: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully [and] wonderfully made: marvellous [are] thy works; and [that] my soul knoweth right well.

ours: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
theirs: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, [and] curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

ours: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
theirs: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all [my members] were written, [which] in continuance were fashioned, when [as yet there was] none of them.

ours: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
theirs: [If] I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

ours: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
theirs: For they speak against thee wickedly, [and] thine enemies take [thy name] in vain.

ours: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
theirs: And see if [there be any] wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

ours: DELIVER me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
theirs: <<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

ours: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
theirs: Which imagine mischiefs in [their] heart; continually are they gathered together [for] war.

ours: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders poison is under their lips. Selah.
theirs: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison [is] under their lips. Selah.

ours: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
theirs: I said unto the LORD, Thou [art] my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.

ours: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
theirs: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; [lest] they exalt themselves. Selah.

ours: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
theirs: [As for] the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

ours: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
theirs: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow [him].

ours: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
theirs: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, [and] the right of the poor.

ours: LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
theirs: <<A Psalm of David.>> LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

ours: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
theirs: Let my prayer be set forth before thee [as] incense; [and] the lifting up of my hands [as] the evening sacrifice.

ours: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
theirs: Incline not my heart to [any] evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

ours: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
theirs: Let the righteous smite me; [it shall be] a kindness: and let him reprove me; [it shall be] an excellent oil, [which] shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also [shall be] in their calamities.

ours: Our bones are scattered at the graves mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
theirs: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth [wood] upon the earth.

ours: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
theirs: But mine eyes [are] unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

ours: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
theirs: Keep me from the snares [which] they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

ours: I CRIED unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
theirs: <<Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave.>> I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.

ours: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
theirs: I looked on [my] right hand, and beheld, but [there was] no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

ours: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
theirs: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou [art] my refuge [and] my portion in the land of the living.

ours: HEAR my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
theirs: <<A Psalm of David.>> Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, [and] in thy righteousness.

ours: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
theirs: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul [thirsteth] after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

ours: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
theirs: Teach me to do thy will; for thou [art] my God: thy spirit [is] good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

ours: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy names sake: for thy righteousness sake bring my soul out of trouble.
theirs: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

ours: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
theirs: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I [am] thy servant.

ours: BLESSED be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
theirs: <<[A Psalm] of David.>> Blessed [be] the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, [and] my fingers to fight:

ours: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
theirs: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and [he] in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

ours: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
theirs: LORD, what [is] man, that thou takest knowledge of him! [or] the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

ours: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
theirs: Man is like to vanity: his days [are] as a shadow that passeth away.

ours: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
theirs: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand [is] a right hand of falsehood.

ours: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
theirs: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery [and] an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

ours: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
theirs: [It is he] that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

ours: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
theirs: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand [is] a right hand of falsehood:

ours: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
theirs: That our sons [may be] as plants grown up in their youth; [that] our daughters [may be] as corner stones, polished [after] the similitude of a palace:

ours: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
theirs: [That] our garners [may be] full, affording all manner of store: [that] our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

ours: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
theirs: [That] our oxen [may be] strong to labour; [that there be] no breaking in, nor going out; that [there be] no complaining in our streets.

ours: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.
theirs: Happy [is that] people, that is in such a case: [yea], happy [is that] people, whose God [is] the LORD.

ours: I WILL extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
theirs: <<David's [Psalm] of praise.>> I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

ours: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
theirs: Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness [is] unsearchable.

ours: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
theirs: And [men] shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

ours: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
theirs: The LORD [is] gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

ours: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
theirs: The LORD [is] good to all: and his tender mercies [are] over all his works.

ours: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
theirs: Thy kingdom [is] an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion [endureth] throughout all generations.

ours: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
theirs: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all [those that be] bowed down.

ours: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
theirs: The LORD [is] righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

ours: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
theirs: The LORD [is] nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

ours: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
theirs: Put not your trust in princes, [nor] in the son of man, in whom [there is] no help.

ours: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
theirs: Happy [is he] that [hath] the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope [is] in the LORD his God:

ours: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
theirs: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein [is]: which keepeth truth for ever:

ours: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
theirs: The LORD openeth [the eyes of] the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:

ours: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
theirs: The LORD shall reign for ever, [even] thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.

ours: PRAISE ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
theirs: Praise ye the LORD: for [it is] good to sing praises unto our God; for [it is] pleasant; [and] praise is comely.

ours: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
theirs: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by [their] names.

ours: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
theirs: Great [is] our Lord, and of great power: his understanding [is] infinite.

ours: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
theirs: He giveth to the beast his food, [and] to the young ravens which cry.

ours: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
theirs: He maketh peace [in] thy borders, [and] filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

ours: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
theirs: He sendeth forth his commandment [upon] earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

ours: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
theirs: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, [and] the waters flow.

ours: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
theirs: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and [as for his] judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.

ours: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
theirs: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that [be] above the heavens.

ours: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
theirs: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory [is] above the earth and heaven.

ours: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
theirs: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; [even] of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.

ours: PRAISE ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
theirs: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, [and] his praise in the congregation of saints.

ours: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
theirs: [Let] the high [praises] of God [be] in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;

ours: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
theirs: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, [and] punishments upon the people;

ours: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
theirs: A wise [man] will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

ours: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
theirs: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of knowledge: [but] fools despise wisdom and instruction.

ours: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
theirs: For they [shall be] an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.

ours: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
theirs: And they lay wait for their [own] blood; they lurk privily for their [own] lives.

ours: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
theirs: So [are] the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; [which] taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

ours: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
theirs: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, [saying],

ours: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
theirs: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, [and] apply thine heart to understanding;

ours: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
theirs: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, [and] liftest up thy voice for understanding;

ours: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
theirs: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as [for] hid treasures;

ours: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
theirs: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth [cometh] knowledge and understanding.

ours: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
theirs: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: [he is] a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

ours: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
theirs: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; [yea], every good path.

ours: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
theirs: To deliver thee from the way of the evil [man], from the man that speaketh froward things;

ours: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
theirs: Who rejoice to do evil, [and] delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

ours: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
theirs: Whose ways [are] crooked, and [they] froward in their paths:

ours: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
theirs: To deliver thee from the strange woman, [even] from the stranger [which] flattereth with her words;

ours: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
theirs: That thou mayest walk in the way of good [men], and keep the paths of the righteous.

ours: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
theirs: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son [in whom] he delighteth.

ours: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
theirs: Happy [is] the man [that] findeth wisdom, and the man [that] getteth understanding.

ours: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
theirs: For the merchandise of it [is] better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

ours: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
theirs: She [is] more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

ours: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
theirs: Length of days [is] in her right hand; [and] in her left hand riches and honour.

ours: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
theirs: Her ways [are] ways of pleasantness, and all her paths [are] peace.

ours: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
theirs: She [is] a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy [is every one] that retaineth her.

ours: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
theirs: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do [it].

ours: For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.
theirs: For the froward [is] abomination to the LORD: but his secret [is] with the righteous.

ours: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
theirs: The curse of the LORD [is] in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.

ours: For I was my fathers son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
theirs: For I was my father's son, tender and only [beloved] in the sight of my mother.

ours: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
theirs: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget [it] not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

ours: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
theirs: Wisdom [is] the principal thing; [therefore] get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

ours: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
theirs: Take fast hold of instruction; let [her] not go: keep her; for she [is] thy life.

ours: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
theirs: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil [men].

ours: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
theirs: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause [some] to fall.

ours: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
theirs: But the path of the just [is] as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

ours: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
theirs: The way of the wicked [is] as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

ours: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
theirs: For they [are] life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.

ours: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
theirs: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it [are] the issues of life.

ours: MY son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
theirs: My son, attend unto my wisdom, [and] bow thine ear to my understanding:

ours: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
theirs: That thou mayest regard discretion, and [that] thy lips may keep knowledge.

ours: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
theirs: For the lips of a strange woman drop [as] an honeycomb, and her mouth [is] smoother than oil:

ours: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.
theirs: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, [that] thou canst not know [them].

ours: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
theirs: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours [be] in the house of a stranger;

ours: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
theirs: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, [and] rivers of waters in the streets.

ours: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers with thee.
theirs: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.

ours: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
theirs: [Let her be as] the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
