theirs: But when the Pharisees saw [it], they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.

ours: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
theirs: But I say unto you, That in this place is [one] greater than the temple.

ours: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
theirs: But if ye had known what [this] meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

ours: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
theirs: And, behold, there was a man which had [his] hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

ours: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
theirs: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift [it] out?

ours: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
theirs: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched [it] forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.

ours: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
theirs: But when Jesus knew [it], he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;

ours: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
theirs: But when the Pharisees heard [it], they said, This [fellow] doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.

ours: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
theirs: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast [them] out? therefore they shall be your judges.

ours: Or else how can one enter into a strong mans house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
theirs: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

ours: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
theirs: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy [against] the [Holy] Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

ours: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
theirs: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the [world] to come.

ours: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
theirs: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by [his] fruit.

ours: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whales belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
theirs: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

ours: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
theirs: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas [is] here.

ours: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
theirs: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon [is] here.

ours: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
theirs: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth [it] empty, swept, and garnished.

ours: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
theirs: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last [state] of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

ours: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
theirs: While he yet talked to the people, behold, [his] mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.

ours: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
theirs: And when he sowed, some [seeds] fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

ours: For this peoples heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
theirs: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and [their] ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with [their] eyes, and hear with [their] ears, and should understand with [their] heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

ours: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
theirs: But blessed [are] your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

ours: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
theirs: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous [men] have desired to see [those things] which ye see, and have not seen [them]; and to hear [those things] which ye hear, and have not heard [them].

ours: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
theirs: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth [it] not, then cometh the wicked [one], and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

ours: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
theirs: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth [it]; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

ours: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
theirs: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked [one];

ours: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
theirs: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe [which is] instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man [that is] an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure [things] new and old.

ours: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
theirs: And it came to pass, [that] when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.

ours: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
theirs: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this [man] this wisdom, and [these] mighty works?

ours: Is not this the carpenters son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
theirs: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

ours: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
theirs: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this [man] all these things?

ours: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias sake, his brother Philips wife.
theirs: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put [him] in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.

ours: But when Herods birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
theirs: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

ours: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptists head in a charger.
theirs: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.

ours: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oaths sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
theirs: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded [it] to be given [her].

ours: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
theirs: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought [it] to her mother.

ours: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
theirs: When Jesus heard [of it], he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard [thereof], they followed him on foot out of the cities.

ours: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
theirs: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to [his] disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

ours: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
theirs: And immediately Jesus stretched forth [his] hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

ours: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
theirs: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to [his] father or [his] mother, [It is] a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;

ours: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
theirs: And honour not his father or his mother, [he shall be free]. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.

ours: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
theirs: [Ye] hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

ours: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
theirs: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with [their] lips; but their heart is far from me.

ours: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
theirs: But in vain they do worship me, teaching [for] doctrines the commandments of men.

ours: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
theirs: These are [the things] which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.

ours: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
theirs: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, [thou] Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

ours: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the childrens bread, and to cast it to dogs.
theirs: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast [it] to dogs.

ours: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters table.
theirs: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

ours: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
theirs: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great [is] thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.

ours: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus feet; and he healed them:
theirs: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them [those that were] lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:

ours: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
theirs: Then Jesus called his disciples [unto him], and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

ours: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
theirs: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake [them], and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

ours: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
theirs: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken [meat] that was left seven baskets full.

ours: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
theirs: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, [It will be] fair weather: for the sky is red.

ours: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
theirs: And in the morning, [It will be] foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O [ye] hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not [discern] the signs of the times?

ours: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
theirs: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, [It is] because we have taken no bread.

ours: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
theirs: [Which] when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

ours: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
theirs: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake [it] not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

ours: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
theirs: Then understood they how that he bade [them] not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

ours: When Jesus came into the coasts of Cæsarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
theirs: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

ours: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
theirs: And they said, Some [say that thou art] John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

ours: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
theirs: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed [it] unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

ours: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
theirs: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any [man] will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

ours: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
theirs: And when the disciples heard [it], they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

ours: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
theirs: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a [certain] man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

ours: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
theirs: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute [money] came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

ours: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
theirs: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and [that] he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

ours: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
theirs: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast [them] from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

ours: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
theirs: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast [it] from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

ours: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
theirs: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that [sheep], than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

ours: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
theirs: But if he will not hear [thee, then] take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

ours: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
theirs: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell [it] unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

ours: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
theirs: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took [him] by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

ours: AND it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judæa beyond Jordan;
theirs: And it came to pass, [that] when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;

ours: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
theirs: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made [them] at the beginning made them male and female,

ours: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
theirs: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except [it be] for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

ours: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
theirs: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with [his] wife, it is not good to marry.

ours: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
theirs: But he said unto them, All [men] cannot receive this saying, save [they] to whom it is given.

ours: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mothers womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heavens sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
theirs: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from [their] mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive [it], let him receive [it].

ours: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
theirs: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put [his] hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

ours: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
theirs: And he laid [his] hands on them, and departed thence.

ours: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
theirs: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? [there is] none good but one, [that is], God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

ours: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
theirs: Honour thy father and [thy] mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

ours: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
theirs: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go [and] sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come [and] follow me.

ours: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
theirs: When his disciples heard [it], they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

ours: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
theirs: But Jesus beheld [them], and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

ours: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my names sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
theirs: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

ours: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
theirs: But many [that are] first shall be last; and the last [shall be] first.

ours: FOR the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
theirs: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man [that is] an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

ours: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
theirs: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, [that] shall ye receive.

ours: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
theirs: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them [their] hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

ours: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
theirs: And when they came that [were hired] about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

ours: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
theirs: And when they had received [it], they murmured against the goodman of the house,

ours: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
theirs: Saying, These last have wrought [but] one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

ours: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
theirs: Take [that] thine [is], and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.

ours: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
theirs: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify [him]: and the third day he shall rise again.

ours: Then came to him the mother of Zebedees children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
theirs: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping [him], and desiring a certain thing of him.

ours: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
theirs: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but [it shall be given to them] for whom it is prepared of my Father.

ours: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
theirs: And when the ten heard [it], they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

ours: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
theirs: But Jesus called them [unto him], and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

ours: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
theirs: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, [thou] Son of David.

ours: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
theirs: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, [thou] Son of David.

ours: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
theirs: So Jesus had compassion [on them], and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.

ours: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
theirs: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose [them], and bring [them] unto me.

ours: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
theirs: And if any [man] say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

ours: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
theirs: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set [him] thereon.

ours: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
theirs: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed [them] in the way.

ours: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
theirs: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

ours: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
theirs: And when the disciples saw [it], they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

ours: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
theirs: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this [which is done] to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

ours: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
theirs: But what think ye? A [certain] man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

ours: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
theirs: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I [go], sir: and went not.

ours: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
theirs: Whether of them twain did the will of [his] father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

ours: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
theirs: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen [it], repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

ours: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
theirs: And they caught him, and cast [him] out of the vineyard, and slew [him].

ours: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
theirs: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out [his] vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

ours: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lords doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
theirs: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

ours: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
theirs: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and [my] fatlings [are] killed, and all things [are] ready: come unto the marriage.

ours: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
theirs: But they made light of [it], and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

ours: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
theirs: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated [them] spitefully, and slew [them].

ours: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
theirs: But when the king heard [thereof], he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

ours: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
theirs: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast [him] into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

ours: For many are called, but few are chosen.
theirs: For many are called, but few [are] chosen.

ours: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
theirs: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in [his] talk.

ours: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
theirs: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any [man]: for thou regardest not the person of men.

ours: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Cæsar, or not?
theirs: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?

ours: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
theirs: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, [ye] hypocrites?

ours: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
theirs: And he saith unto them, Whose [is] this image and superscription?

ours: They say unto him, Cæsars. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsars; and unto God the things that are Gods.
theirs: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.

ours: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
theirs: When they had heard [these words], they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.

ours: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
theirs: And when the multitude heard [this], they were astonished at his doctrine.

ours: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
theirs: Then one of them, [which was] a lawyer, asked [him a question], tempting him, and saying,

ours: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
theirs: Master, which [is] the great commandment in the law?

ours: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
theirs: And the second [is] like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

ours: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.
theirs: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, [The Son] of David.

ours: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
theirs: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any [man] from that day forth ask him any more [questions].

ours: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses seat:
theirs: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:

ours: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
theirs: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, [that] observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

ours: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on mens shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
theirs: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay [them] on men's shoulders; but they [themselves] will not move them with one of their fingers.

ours: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
theirs: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, [even] Christ; and all ye are brethren.

ours: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
theirs: And call no [man] your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

ours: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
theirs: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, [even] Christ.

ours: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
theirs: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in [yourselves], neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.

ours: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
theirs: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

ours: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
theirs: Woe unto you, [ye] blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

ours: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
theirs: [Ye] fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

ours: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
theirs: [Ye] fools and blind: for whether [is] greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

ours: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
theirs: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier [matters] of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

ours: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
theirs: [Ye] blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

ours: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
theirs: [Thou] blind Pharisee, cleanse first that [which is] within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

ours: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead mens bones, and of all uncleanness.
theirs: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead [men's] bones, and of all uncleanness.

ours: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
theirs: [Ye] serpents, [ye] generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

ours: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
theirs: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and [some] of them ye shall kill and crucify; and [some] of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute [them] from city to city:

ours: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
theirs: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, [thou] that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under [her] wings, and ye would not!

ours: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
theirs: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

ours: AND Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
theirs: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to [him] for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

ours: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
theirs: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what [shall be] the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

ours: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
theirs: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all [these things] must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

ours: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
theirs: All these [are] the beginning of sorrows.

ours: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my names sake.
theirs: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.

ours: Then let them which be in Judæa flee into the mountains:
theirs: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:

ours: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elects sake those days shall be shortened.
theirs: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.

ours: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
theirs: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here [is] Christ, or there; believe [it] not.

ours: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
theirs: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if [it were] possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

ours: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
theirs: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, [he is] in the secret chambers; believe [it] not.

ours: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
theirs: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer [is] nigh:

ours: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
theirs: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, [even] at the doors.

ours: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
theirs: But of that day and hour knoweth no [man], no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

ours: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
theirs: But as the days of Noe [were], so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

ours: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
theirs: Two [women shall be] grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

ours: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
theirs: Blessed [is] that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

ours: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
theirs: And shall begin to smite [his] fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;

ours: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
theirs: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for [him], and in an hour that he is not aware of,

ours: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
theirs: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint [him] his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

ours: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
theirs: And five of them were wise, and five [were] foolish.

ours: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
theirs: They that [were] foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:

ours: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
theirs: But the wise answered, saying, [Not so]; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

ours: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
theirs: For [the kingdom of heaven is] as a man travelling into a far country, [who] called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

ours: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
theirs: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made [them] other five talents.

ours: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
theirs: And likewise he that [had received] two, he also gained other two.

ours: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lords money.
theirs: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

ours: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
theirs: His lord said unto him, Well done, [thou] good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

ours: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
theirs: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, [there] thou hast [that is] thine.

ours: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
theirs: His lord answered and said unto him, [Thou] wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:

ours: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
theirs: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and [then] at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.

ours: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
theirs: Take therefore the talent from him, and give [it] unto him which hath ten talents.

ours: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
theirs: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth [his] sheep from the goats:

ours: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
theirs: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed [thee]? or thirsty, and gave [thee] drink?

ours: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
theirs: When saw we thee a stranger, and took [thee] in? or naked, and clothed [thee]?

ours: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
theirs: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done [it] unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done [it] unto me.

ours: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
theirs: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did [it] not to one of the least of these, ye did [it] not to me.

ours: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
theirs: Ye know that after two days is [the feast of] the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.

ours: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
theirs: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill [him].

ours: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
theirs: But they said, Not on the feast [day], lest there be an uproar among the people.

ours: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
theirs: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat [at meat].

ours: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
theirs: But when his disciples saw [it], they had indignation, saying, To what purpose [is] this waste?

ours: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
theirs: When Jesus understood [it], he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.

ours: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
theirs: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did [it] for my burial.

ours: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
theirs: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, [there] shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.

ours: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
theirs: And said [unto them], What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.

ours: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
theirs: Now the first [day] of the [feast of] unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?

ours: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
theirs: And he answered and said, He that dippeth [his] hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.

ours: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
theirs: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed [it], and brake [it], and gave [it] to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

ours: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
theirs: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave [it] to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;

ours: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Fathers kingdom.
theirs: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

ours: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
theirs: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all [men] shall be offended because of thee, [yet] will I never be offended.

ours: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
theirs: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou [wilt].

ours: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
theirs: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed [is] willing, but the flesh [is] weak.

ours: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
theirs: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take [your] rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

ours: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priests, and smote off his ear.
theirs: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out [his] hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.

ours: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
theirs: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led [him] away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

ours: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priests palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
theirs: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.

ours: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
theirs: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, [yet] found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,

ours: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
theirs: And said, This [fellow] said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.

ours: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
theirs: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what [is it which] these witness against thee?

ours: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
theirs: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote [him] with the palms of their hands,

ours: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
theirs: But he denied before [them] all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.

ours: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
theirs: And when he was gone out into the porch, another [maid] saw him, and said unto them that were there, This [fellow] was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

ours: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
theirs: And after a while came unto [him] they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art [one] of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.

ours: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
theirs: Then began he to curse and to swear, [saying], I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.

ours: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
theirs: And when they had bound him, they led [him] away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

ours: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
theirs: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What [is that] to us? see thou [to that].

ours: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potters field, to bury strangers in.
theirs: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.

ours: And gave them for the potters field, as the Lord appointed me.
theirs: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.

ours: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
theirs: Now at [that] feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.

ours: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
theirs: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? [They] all say unto him, Let him be crucified.

ours: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
theirs: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but [that] rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed [his] hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye [to it].

ours: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
theirs: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood [be] on us, and on our children.

ours: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
theirs: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered [him] to be crucified.

ours: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
theirs: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band [of soldiers].

ours: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
theirs: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put [it] upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

ours: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
theirs: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify [him].

ours: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
theirs: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted [thereof], he would not drink.

ours: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
theirs: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest [it] in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.

ours: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
theirs: Likewise also the chief priests mocking [him], with the scribes and elders, said,

ours: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
theirs: Some of them that stood there, when they heard [that], said, This [man] calleth for Elias.

ours: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
theirs: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled [it] with vinegar, and put [it] on a reed, and gave him to drink.

ours: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedees children.
theirs: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.

ours: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathæa, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus disciple:
theirs: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:

ours: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
theirs: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make [it] as sure as ye can.

ours: IN the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
theirs: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first [day] of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

ours: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
theirs: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead [men].

ours: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
theirs: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him [away] while we slept.

ours: And if this come to the governors ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
theirs: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

ours: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
theirs: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, [even] unto the end of the world. Amen.

ours: And there went out unto him all the land of Judæa, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
theirs: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.

ours: And John was clothed with camels hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
theirs: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

ours: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
theirs: And there came a voice from heaven, [saying], Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

ours: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
theirs: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the [son] of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

ours: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
theirs: Saying, Let [us] alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

ours: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
theirs: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine [is] this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

ours: But Simons wifes mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
theirs: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.

ours: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
theirs: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All [men] seek for thee.

ours: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
theirs: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth [his] hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.

ours: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
theirs: But he went out, and began to publish [it] much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.

ours: AND again he entered into Capernaum, after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
theirs: And again he entered into Capernaum, after [some] days; and it was noised that he was in the house.

ours: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
theirs: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive [them], no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.

ours: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
theirs: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken [it] up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

ours: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
theirs: Why doth this [man] thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

ours: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
theirs: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, [Thy] sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

ours: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphæus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
theirs: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the [son] of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

ours: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
theirs: When Jesus heard [it], he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

ours: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
theirs: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched [it] out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

ours: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judæa,
theirs: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,

ours: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumæa, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
theirs: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and [from] beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.

ours: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
theirs: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth [unto him] whom he would: and they came unto him.

ours: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
theirs: And James the [son] of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

ours: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphæus, and Thaddæus, and Simon the Canaanite,
theirs: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the [son] of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

ours: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
theirs: And when his friends heard [of it], they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.

ours: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
theirs: And he called them [unto him], and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

ours: No man can enter into a strong mans house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
theirs: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

ours: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
theirs: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all [these] things are done in parables:

ours: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
theirs: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and [their] sins should be forgiven them.

ours: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the words sake, immediately they are offended.
theirs: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.

ours: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
theirs: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive [it], and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

ours: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
theirs: [It is] like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

ours: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
theirs: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear [it].

ours: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
theirs: Who had [his] dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

ours: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
theirs: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any [man] tame him.

ours: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
theirs: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, [thou] Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

ours: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
theirs: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, [thou] unclean spirit.

ours: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
theirs: And he asked him, What [is] thy name? And he answered, saying, My name [is] Legion: for we are many.

ours: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
theirs: And they that fed the swine fled, and told [it] in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

ours: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
theirs: And they that saw [it] told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and [also] concerning the swine.

ours: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
theirs: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all [men] did marvel.

ours: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
theirs: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: [I pray thee], come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

ours: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
theirs: And [Jesus] went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

ours: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
theirs: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in [her] body that she was healed of that plague.

ours: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogues house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
theirs: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's [house certain] which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

ours: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
theirs: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was [of the age] of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

ours: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
theirs: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing [him] were astonished, saying, From whence hath this [man] these things? and what wisdom [is] this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

ours: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
theirs: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed [them].

ours: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
