theirs: And he called [unto him] the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;

ours: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
theirs: And commanded them that they should take nothing for [their] journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in [their] purse:

ours: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
theirs: But [be] shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

ours: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
theirs: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed [them].

ours: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
theirs: And king Herod heard [of him]; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

ours: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
theirs: But when Herod heard [thereof], he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.

ours: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias sake, his brother Philips wife: for he had married her.
theirs: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.

ours: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brothers wife.
theirs: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.

ours: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
theirs: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief [estates] of Galilee;

ours: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
theirs: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give [it] thee.

ours: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
theirs: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give [it] thee, unto the half of my kingdom.

ours: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oaths sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
theirs: And the king was exceeding sorry; [yet] for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.

ours: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
theirs: And when his disciples heard [of it], they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

ours: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
theirs: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time [is] far passed:

ours: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
theirs: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave [them] to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.

ours: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
theirs: For they considered not [the miracle] of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

ours: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
theirs: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash [their] hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

ours: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
theirs: And [when they come] from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, [as] the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

ours: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
theirs: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with [their] lips, but their heart is far from me.

ours: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
theirs: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching [for] doctrines the commandments of men.

ours: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
theirs: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, [as] the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

ours: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
theirs: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, [It is] Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; [he shall be free].

ours: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
theirs: And when he had called all the people [unto him], he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one [of you], and understand:

ours: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
theirs: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, [it] cannot defile him;

ours: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
theirs: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know [it]: but he could not be hid.

ours: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
theirs: For a [certain] woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:

ours: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the childrens bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
theirs: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast [it] unto the dogs.

ours: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the childrens crumbs.
theirs: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.

ours: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
theirs: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published [it];

ours: IN those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
theirs: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples [unto him], and saith unto them,

ours: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
theirs: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these [men] with bread here in the wilderness?

ours: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
theirs: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before [them]; and they did set [them] before the people.

ours: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
theirs: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before [them].

ours: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
theirs: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken [meat] that was left seven baskets.

ours: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
theirs: Now [the disciples] had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

ours: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
theirs: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and [of] the leaven of Herod.

ours: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
theirs: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, [It is] because we have no bread.

ours: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
theirs: And when Jesus knew [it], he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

ours: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
theirs: After that he put [his] hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

ours: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
theirs: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell [it] to any in the town.

ours: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Cæsarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
theirs: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

ours: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
theirs: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some [say], Elias; and others, One of the prophets.

ours: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
theirs: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and [of] the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

ours: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
theirs: And when he had called the people [unto him] with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

ours: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospels, the same shall save it.
theirs: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

ours: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
theirs: And after six days Jesus taketh [with him] Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

ours: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
theirs: And when he came to [his] disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

ours: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
theirs: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to [him] saluted him.

ours: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
theirs: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things [are] possible to him that believeth.

ours: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
theirs: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, [Thou] dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

ours: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
theirs: And [the spirit] cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.

ours: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
theirs: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know [it].

ours: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
theirs: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who [should be] the greatest.

ours: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
theirs: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, [the same] shall be last of all, and servant of all.

ours: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
theirs: And whosoever shall offend one of [these] little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

ours: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
theirs: Salt [is] good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

ours: AND he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judæa by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
theirs: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.

ours: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
theirs: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away [his] wife? tempting him.

ours: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
theirs: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put [her] away.

ours: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
theirs: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same [matter].

ours: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
theirs: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and [his] disciples rebuked those that brought [them].

ours: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
theirs: But when Jesus saw [it], he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

ours: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
theirs: And he took them up in his arms, put [his] hands upon them, and blessed them.

ours: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
theirs: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? [there is] none good but one, [that is], God.

ours: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
theirs: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men [it is] impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

ours: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospels,
theirs: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,

ours: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
theirs: But many [that are] first shall be last; and the last first.

ours: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
theirs: [Saying], Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

ours: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
theirs: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but [it shall be given to them] for whom it is prepared.

ours: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
theirs: And when the ten heard [it], they began to be much displeased with James and John.

ours: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
theirs: But Jesus called them [to him], and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

ours: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimæus, the son of Timæus, sat by the highway side begging.
theirs: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.

ours: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
theirs: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, [thou] Son of David, have mercy on me.

ours: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
theirs: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, [Thou] Son of David, have mercy on me.

ours: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
theirs: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring [him].

ours: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
theirs: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed [them] in the way.

ours: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
theirs: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

ours: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
theirs: Blessed [be] the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

ours: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
theirs: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not [yet].

ours: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
theirs: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard [it].

ours: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
theirs: And would not suffer that any man should carry [any] vessel through the temple.

ours: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
theirs: And the scribes and chief priests heard [it], and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

ours: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
theirs: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive [them], and ye shall have [them].

ours: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
theirs: The baptism of John, was [it] from heaven, or of men? answer me.

ours: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
theirs: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all [men] counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

ours: AND he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
theirs: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A [certain] man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about [it], and digged [a place for] the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

ours: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
theirs: And they caught [him], and beat him, and sent [him] away empty.

ours: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
theirs: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded [him] in the head, and sent [him] away shamefully handled.

ours: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
theirs: And they took him, and killed [him], and cast [him] out of the vineyard.

ours: This was the Lords doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
theirs: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

ours: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
theirs: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in [his] words.

ours: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Cæsar, or not?
theirs: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

ours: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
theirs: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see [it].

ours: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Cæsars.
theirs: And they brought [it]. And he saith unto them, Whose [is] this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.

ours: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Cæsar the things that are Cæsars, and to God the things that are Gods. And they marvelled at him.
theirs: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.

ours: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a mans brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
theirs: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave [his] wife [behind him], and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

ours: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
theirs: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I [am] the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

ours: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
theirs: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments [is], Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

ours: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
theirs: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this [is] the first commandment.

ours: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
theirs: And the second [is] like, [namely] this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

ours: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
theirs: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love [his] neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

ours: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
theirs: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him [any question].

ours: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
theirs: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he [then] his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

ours: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
theirs: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and [love] salutations in the marketplaces,

ours: Which devour widows houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
theirs: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

ours: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
theirs: And he called [unto him] his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

ours: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
theirs: For all [they] did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, [even] all her living.

ours: AND as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
theirs: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings [are here]!

ours: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
theirs: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what [shall be] the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

ours: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
theirs: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any [man] deceive you:

ours: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
theirs: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am [Christ]; and shall deceive many.

ours: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
theirs: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for [such things] must needs be; but the end [shall] not [be] yet.

ours: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
theirs: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these [are] the beginnings of sorrows.

ours: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
theirs: But when they shall lead [you], and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

ours: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
theirs: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against [their] parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

ours: And ye shall be hated of all men for my names sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
theirs: And ye shall be hated of all [men] for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

ours: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judæa flee to the mountains:
theirs: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:

ours: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
theirs: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter [therein], to take any thing out of his house:

ours: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
theirs: For [in] those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

ours: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elects sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
theirs: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

ours: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
theirs: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here [is] Christ; or, lo, [he is] there; believe [him] not:

ours: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
theirs: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if [it were] possible, even the elect.

ours: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
theirs: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, [even] at the doors.

ours: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
theirs: But of that day and [that] hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

ours: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
theirs: [For the Son of man is] as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

ours: AFTER two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
theirs: After two days was [the feast of] the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put [him] to death.

ours: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
theirs: But they said, Not on the feast [day], lest there be an uproar of the people.

ours: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
theirs: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured [it] on his head.

ours: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
theirs: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, [this] also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

ours: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
theirs: And when they heard [it], they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

ours: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
theirs: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished [and] prepared: there make ready for us.

ours: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
theirs: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, [Is] it I? and another [said, Is] it I?

ours: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
theirs: And he answered and said unto them, [It is] one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

ours: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
theirs: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake [it], and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

ours: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
theirs: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave [it] to them: and they all drank of it.

ours: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
theirs: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet [will] not I.

ours: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
theirs: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, [even] in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

ours: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
theirs: And he said, Abba, Father, all things [are] possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

ours: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
theirs: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly [is] ready, but the flesh [is] weak.

ours: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
theirs: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take [your] rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

ours: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
theirs: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead [him] away safely.

ours: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
theirs: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and [with] staves to take me?

ours: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
theirs: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about [his] naked [body]; and the young men laid hold on him:

ours: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
theirs: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what [is it which] these witness against thee?

ours: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
theirs: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is [one] of them.

ours: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilæan, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
theirs: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art [one] of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth [thereto].

ours: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
theirs: But he began to curse and to swear, [saying], I know not this man of whom ye speak.

ours: AND straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
theirs: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried [him] away, and delivered [him] to Pilate.

ours: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.
theirs: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest [it].

ours: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
theirs: Now at [that] feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

ours: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
theirs: And there was [one] named Barabbas, [which lay] bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

ours: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
theirs: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire [him to do] as he had ever done unto them.

ours: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
theirs: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do [unto him] whom ye call the King of the Jews?

ours: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
theirs: And [so] Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged [him], to be crucified.

ours: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Prætorium; and they call together the whole band.
theirs: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.

ours: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
theirs: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his [head],

ours: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
theirs: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing [their] knees worshipped him.

ours: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
theirs: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received [it] not.

ours: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
theirs: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest [it] in three days,

ours: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
theirs: And some of them that stood by, when they heard [it], said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

ours: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
theirs: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put [it] on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

ours: Joseph of Arimathæa, an honourable counseller, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
theirs: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counseller, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

ours: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
theirs: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling [unto him] the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

ours: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
theirs: And when he knew [it] of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

ours: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
theirs: And Mary Magdalene and Mary [the mother] of Joses beheld where he was laid.

ours: AND when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
theirs: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the [mother] of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

ours: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
theirs: And very early in the morning the first [day] of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

ours: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
theirs: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any [man]; for they were afraid.

ours: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
theirs: Now when [Jesus] was risen early the first [day] of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

ours: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
theirs: [And] she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

ours: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
theirs: And they went and told [it] unto the residue: neither believed they them.

ours: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
theirs: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with [them], and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.

ours: THERE was in the days of Herod, the king of Judæa, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
theirs: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife [was] of the daughters of Aaron, and her name [was] Elisabeth.

ours: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
theirs: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were [now] well stricken in years.

ours: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priests office before God in the order of his course,
theirs: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,

ours: According to the custom of the priests office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
theirs: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

ours: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
theirs: And when Zacharias saw [him], he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

ours: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mothers womb.
theirs: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.

ours: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
theirs: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on [me], to take away my reproach among men.

ours: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgins name was Mary.
theirs: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name [was] Mary.

ours: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
theirs: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, [thou that art] highly favoured, the Lord [is] with thee: blessed [art] thou among women.

ours: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
theirs: And when she saw [him], she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

ours: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
theirs: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed [art] thou among women, and blessed [is] the fruit of thy womb.

ours: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
theirs: And whence [is] this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

ours: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
theirs: And blessed [is] she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

ours: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
theirs: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy [is] his name.

ours: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
theirs: And his mercy [is] on them that fear him from generation to generation.

ours: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
theirs: He hath put down the mighty from [their] seats, and exalted them of low degree.

ours: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
theirs: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of [his] mercy;

ours: Now Elisabeths full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
theirs: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

ours: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
theirs: And his mother answered and said, Not [so]; but he shall be called John.

ours: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
theirs: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue [loosed], and he spake, and praised God.

ours: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judæa.
theirs: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.

ours: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
theirs: And all they that heard [them] laid [them] up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

ours: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
theirs: Blessed [be] the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

ours: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
theirs: To perform the mercy [promised] to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

ours: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
theirs: To give light to them that sit in darkness and [in] the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

ours: AND it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Cæsar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
theirs: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

ours: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
theirs: ([And] this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

ours: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
theirs: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

ours: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
theirs: And this [shall be] a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

ours: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
theirs: And when they had seen [it], they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

ours: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
theirs: And all they that heard [it] wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

ours: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
theirs: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered [them] in her heart.

theirs: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present [him] to the Lord;

ours: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
theirs: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name [was] Simeon; and the same man [was] just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

theirs: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

ours: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
theirs: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this [child] is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

ours: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
theirs: And she [was] a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served [God] with fastings and prayers night and day.

ours: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
theirs: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not [of it].

ours: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a days journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
theirs: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among [their] kinsfolk and acquaintance.

ours: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Fathers business?
theirs: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?

ours: NOW in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cæsar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judæa, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituræa and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
theirs: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

ours: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
theirs: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to [our] father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

ours: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
theirs: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse [any] falsely; and be content with your wages.

ours: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

theirs: Which was [the son] of Matthat, which was [the son] of Levi, which was [the son] of Melchi, which was [the son] of Janna, which was [the son] of Joseph,

ours: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,

theirs: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing [their] nets.

theirs: And he put forth [his] hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

theirs: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought [means] to bring him in, and to lay [him] before him.

ours: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

ours: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
theirs: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was [taken] out of the new agreeth not with the old.

theirs: No man also having drunk old [wine] straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

ours: AND it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
theirs: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing [them] in [their] hands.

ours: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
theirs: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy [it]?

ours: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
theirs: And when it was day, he called [unto him] his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

theirs: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

ours: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
theirs: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed [them] all.

theirs: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed [be ye] poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

ours: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
theirs: Blessed [are ye] that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed [are ye] that weep now: for ye shall laugh.

ours: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of mans sake.
theirs: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you [from their company], and shall reproach [you], and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.

ours: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
theirs: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward [is] great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.

theirs: And unto him that smiteth thee on the [one] cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not [to take thy] coat also.

ours: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
theirs: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask [them] not again.

ours: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
theirs: And if ye lend [to them] of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

ours: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
theirs: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and [to] the evil.

ours: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brothers eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
theirs: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

ours: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brothers eye.
theirs: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

ours: And a certain centurions servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
theirs: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

theirs: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth [it].

theirs: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare [him] stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.

ours: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
theirs: And John calling [unto him] two of his disciples sent [them] to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

ours: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
theirs: And in that same hour he cured many of [their] infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many [that were] blind he gave sight.

ours: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
theirs: And blessed is [he], whosoever shall not be offended in me.

theirs: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

theirs: And all the people that heard [him], and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

theirs: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.

ours: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisees house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
theirs: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that [Jesus] sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

ours: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
theirs: And stood at his feet behind [him] weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe [them] with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed [them] with the ointment.

ours: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

ours: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
theirs: Simon answered and said, I suppose that [he], to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

ours: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
theirs: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped [them] with the hairs of her head.

ours: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
theirs: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, [the same] loveth little.

ours: AND it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,

ours: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herods steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

ours: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
theirs: They on the rock [are they], which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

ours: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
theirs: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of [this] life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

ours: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
theirs: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep [it], and bring forth fruit with patience.

ours: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
theirs: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth [it] under a bed; but setteth [it] on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

ours: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
theirs: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither [any thing] hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

ours: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
theirs: Then came to him [his] mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.

ours: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

theirs: When they that fed [them] saw what was done, they fled, and went and told [it] in the city and in the country.

theirs: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people [gladly] received him: for they were all waiting for him.

theirs: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press [thee], and sayest thou, Who touched me?

theirs: And the people, when they knew [it], followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.

ours: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
theirs: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some [say], Elias; and others [say], that one of the old prophets is risen again.

ours: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
theirs: And he straitly charged them, and commanded [them] to tell no man that thing;

ours: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
theirs: And he said to [them] all, If any [man] will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

theirs: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and [in his] Father's, and of the holy angels.

ours: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.
theirs: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment [was] white [and] glistering.

ours: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
theirs: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept [it] close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.

ours: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
theirs: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare [him]. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.

ours: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
theirs: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid [him] not: for he that is not against us is for us.

ours: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
theirs: And when his disciples James and John saw [this], they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

ours: For the Son of man is not come to destroy mens lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
theirs: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save [them]. And they went to another village.

ours: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
theirs: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain [man] said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

ours: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
theirs: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air [have] nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay [his] head.

ours: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
theirs: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly [is] great, but the labourers [are] few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

ours: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
theirs: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace [be] to this house.

ours: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
theirs: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and [he] to whom the Son will reveal [him].

ours: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
theirs: And he turned him unto [his] disciples, and said privately, Blessed [are] the eyes which see the things that ye see:

ours: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
theirs: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen [them]; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard [them].

ours: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
theirs: And Jesus answering said, A certain [man] went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded [him], and departed, leaving [him] half dead.

ours: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
theirs: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked [on him], and passed by on the other side.

ours: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
theirs: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion [on him],

ours: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
theirs: And went to [him], and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

ours: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
theirs: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave [them] to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

ours: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus feet, and heard his word.
theirs: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

ours: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
theirs: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if [he ask] a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

ours: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
theirs: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall [your] heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

ours: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
theirs: And others, tempting [him], sought of him a sign from heaven.

ours: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
theirs: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house [divided] against a house falleth.

ours: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
theirs: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast [them] out? therefore shall they be your judges.

ours: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
theirs: And when he cometh, he findeth [it] swept and garnished.

ours: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
theirs: Then goeth he, and taketh [to him] seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last [state] of that man is worse than the first.

ours: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
theirs: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed [is] the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.

ours: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
theirs: But he said, Yea rather, blessed [are] they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

ours: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
theirs: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon [is] here.

ours: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
theirs: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas [is] here.
