ours: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
theirs: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth [it] in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.

ours: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
theirs: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when [thine eye] is evil, thy body also [is] full of darkness.

ours: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
theirs: If thy whole body therefore [be] full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.

ours: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
theirs: And when the Pharisee saw [it], he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

ours: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
theirs: [Ye] fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

ours: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
theirs: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over [them] are not aware [of them].

ours: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
theirs: And he said, Woe unto you also, [ye] lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

ours: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
theirs: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and [some] of them they shall slay and persecute:

ours: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
theirs: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge [him] vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

ours: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
theirs: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and [unto] magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:

ours: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a mans life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
theirs: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

ours: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
theirs: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, [and] be merry.

ours: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?
theirs: But God said unto him, [Thou] fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?

ours: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
theirs: So [is] he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

ours: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
theirs: The life is more than meat, and the body [is more] than raiment.

ours: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?
theirs: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more [will he clothe] you, O ye of little faith?

ours: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Fathers good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
theirs: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

ours: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
theirs: Let your loins be girded about, and [your] lights burning;

ours: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
theirs: Blessed [are] those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.

ours: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
theirs: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find [them] so, blessed are those servants.

ours: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
theirs: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom [his] lord shall make ruler over his household, to give [them their] portion of meat in due season?

ours: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
theirs: Blessed [is] that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

ours: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
theirs: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for [him], and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

ours: And that servant, which knew his lords will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
theirs: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not [himself], neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many [stripes].

ours: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
theirs: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few [stripes]. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

ours: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
theirs: And when [ye see] the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.

ours: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
theirs: [Ye] hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?

ours: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
theirs: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, [as thou art] in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

ours: THERE were present at that season some that told him of the Galilæans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
theirs: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

ours: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilæans were sinners above all the Galilæans, because they suffered such things?
theirs: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?

ours: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
theirs: He spake also this parable; A certain [man] had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

ours: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
theirs: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung [it]:

ours: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.
theirs: And if it bear fruit, [well]: and if not, [then] after that thou shalt cut it down.

ours: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
theirs: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up [herself].

ours: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
theirs: And when Jesus saw her, he called [her to him], and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.

ours: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
theirs: And he laid [his] hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

ours: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
theirs: The Lord then answered him, and said, [Thou] hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or [his] ass from the stall, and lead [him] away to watering?

ours: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
theirs: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all [ye] workers of iniquity.

ours: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
theirs: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you [yourselves] thrust out.

ours: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
theirs: And they shall come from the east, and [from] the west, and from the north, and [from] the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.

ours: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
theirs: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third [day] I shall be perfected.

ours: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
theirs: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the [day] following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

ours: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!
theirs: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen [doth gather] her brood under [her] wings, and ye would not!

ours: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
theirs: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until [the time] come when ye shall say, Blessed [is] he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

ours: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;
theirs: And they held their peace. And he took [him], and healed him, and let him go;

ours: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
theirs: When thou art bidden of any [man] to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;

ours: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
theirs: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor [thy] rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.

ours: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
theirs: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed [is] he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

ours: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.
theirs: And they all with one [consent] began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.

ours: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
theirs: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel [them] to come in, that my house may be filled.

ours: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
theirs: If any [man] come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

ours: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
theirs: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have [sufficient] to finish [it]?

ours: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,
theirs: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish [it], all that behold [it] begin to mock him,

ours: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
theirs: Salt [is] good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?

ours: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
theirs: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; [but] men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

ours: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
theirs: And when he hath found [it], he layeth [it] on his shoulders, rejoicing.

ours: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
theirs: And when he cometh home, he calleth together [his] friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

ours: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?
theirs: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find [it]?

ours: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
theirs: And when she hath found [it], she calleth [her] friends and [her] neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

ours: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
theirs: And the younger of them said to [his] father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth [to me]. And he divided unto them [his] living.

ours: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my fathers have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
theirs: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!

ours: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
theirs: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put [it] on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on [his] feet:

ours: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
theirs: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill [it]; and let us eat, and be merry:

ours: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
theirs: And he answering said to [his] father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

ours: So he called every one of his lords debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
theirs: So he called every one of his lord's debtors [unto him], and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

ours: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
theirs: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true [riches]?

ours: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another mans, who shall give you that which is your own?
theirs: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?

ours: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
theirs: The law and the prophets [were] until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

ours: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.
theirs: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from [her] husband committeth adultery.

ours: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich mans table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
theirs: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

ours: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abrahams bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
theirs: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

ours: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.
theirs: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that [would come] from thence.

ours: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my fathers house:
theirs: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:

ours: THEN said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!
theirs: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe [unto him], through whom they come!

ours: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
theirs: And they lifted up [their] voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

ours: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
theirs: And when he saw [them], he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

ours: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
theirs: And fell down on [his] face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

ours: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
theirs: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where [are] the nine?

ours: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.
theirs: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see [it].

ours: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.
theirs: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after [them], nor follow [them].

ours: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
theirs: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one [part] under heaven, shineth unto the other [part] under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

ours: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
theirs: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed [them] all.

ours: Remember Lots wife.
theirs: Remember Lot's wife.

ours: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
theirs: I tell you, in that night there shall be two [men] in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

ours: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
theirs: Two [women] shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

ours: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
theirs: Two [men] shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

ours: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
theirs: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body [is], thither will the eagles be gathered together.

ours: AND he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
theirs: And he spake a parable unto them [to this end], that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

ours: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
theirs: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men [are], extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

ours: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
theirs: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as [his] eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

ours: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
theirs: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified [rather] than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

ours: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
theirs: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when [his] disciples saw [it], they rebuked them.

ours: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
theirs: But Jesus called them [unto him], and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

ours: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.
theirs: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none [is] good, save one, [that is], God.

ours: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needles eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
theirs: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

ours: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
theirs: And they that heard [it] said, Who then can be saved?

ours: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of Gods sake,
theirs: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

ours: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
theirs: Then he took [unto him] the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

ours: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
theirs: And they shall scourge [him], and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.

ours: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
theirs: And he cried, saying, Jesus, [thou] Son of David, have mercy on me.

ours: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
theirs: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, [Thou] Son of David, have mercy on me.

ours: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
theirs: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw [it], gave praise unto God.

ours: AND Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
theirs: And [Jesus] entered and passed through Jericho.

ours: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchæus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
theirs: And, behold, [there was] a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

ours: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
theirs: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that [way].

ours: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
theirs: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

ours: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
theirs: And when they saw [it], they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

ours: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
theirs: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore [him] fourfold.

ours: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
theirs: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this [man] to reign over us.

ours: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
theirs: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, [here is] thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

ours: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
theirs: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, [thou] wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

ours: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.
theirs: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give [it] to him that hath ten pounds.

ours: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
theirs: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay [them] before me.

ours: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
theirs: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called [the mount] of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

ours: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.
theirs: Saying, Go ye into the village over against [you]; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring [him hither].

ours: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
theirs: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose [him]? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

ours: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
theirs: Saying, Blessed [be] the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

ours: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
theirs: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things [which belong] unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

ours: AND it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
theirs: And it came to pass, [that] on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon [him] with the elders,

ours: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
theirs: And they answered, that they could not tell whence [it was].

ours: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
theirs: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent [him] away empty.

ours: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
theirs: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated [him] shamefully, and sent [him] away empty.

ours: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
theirs: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast [him] out.

ours: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
theirs: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence [him] when they see him.

ours: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
theirs: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed [him]. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

ours: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
theirs: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard [it], they said, God forbid.

ours: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
theirs: And they watched [him], and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

ours: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:
theirs: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person [of any], but teachest the way of God truly:

ours: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cæsar, or no?
theirs: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?

ours: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Cæsars.
theirs: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.

ours: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which be Cæsars, and unto God the things which be Gods.
theirs: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.

ours: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
theirs: Then came to [him] certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

ours: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any mans brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
theirs: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

ours: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
theirs: And after that they durst not ask him any [question at all].

ours: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is Davids son?
theirs: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?

ours: Which devour widows houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
theirs: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.

ours: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
theirs: [As for] these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

ours: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
theirs: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign [will there be] when these things shall come to pass?

ours: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
theirs: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am [Christ]; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

ours: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
theirs: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end [is] not by and by.

ours: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my names sake.
theirs: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute [you], delivering [you] up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

ours: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
theirs: Settle [it] therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

ours: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
theirs: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and [some] of you shall they cause to be put to death.

ours: And ye shall be hated of all men for my names sake.
theirs: And ye shall be hated of all [men] for my name's sake.

ours: Then let them which are in Judæa flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
theirs: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

ours: Mens hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
theirs: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

ours: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
theirs: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and [so] that day come upon you unawares.

ours: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
theirs: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called [the mount] of Olives.

ours: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
theirs: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide [it] among yourselves:

ours: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
theirs: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake [it], and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

ours: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
theirs: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup [is] the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

ours: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
theirs: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me [is] with me on the table.

ours: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
theirs: But ye [shall] not [be] so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

ours: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
theirs: For whether [is] greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? [is] not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

ours: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
theirs: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired [to have] you, that he may sift [you] as wheat:

ours: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
theirs: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take [it], and likewise [his] scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.

ours: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
theirs: And they said, Lord, behold, here [are] two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

ours: And he was withdrawn from them about a stones cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
theirs: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

ours: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priests house. And Peter followed afar off.
theirs: Then took they him, and led [him], and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

ours: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilæan.
theirs: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this [fellow] also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.

ours: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
theirs: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote [him].

ours: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
theirs: And if I also ask [you], ye will not answer me, nor let [me] go.

ours: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
theirs: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this [fellow] perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

ours: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
theirs: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest [it].

ours: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
theirs: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and [to] the people, I find no fault in this man.

ours: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilæan.
theirs: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.

ours: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herods jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
theirs: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

ours: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
theirs: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long [season], because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

ours: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
theirs: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked [him], and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

ours: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
theirs: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined [him] before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:

ours: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
theirs: I will therefore chastise him, and release [him].

ours: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
theirs: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this [man], and release unto us Barabbas:

ours: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
theirs: But they cried, saying, Crucify [him], crucify him.

ours: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
theirs: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let [him] go.

ours: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
theirs: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear [it] after Jesus.

ours: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
theirs: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed [are] the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

ours: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
theirs: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided [him], saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.

ours: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counseller; and he was a good man, and a just:
theirs: And, behold, [there was] a man named Joseph, a counseller; [and he was] a good man, and a just:

ours: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathæa, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
theirs: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) [he was] of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

ours: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
theirs: This [man] went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

ours: NOW upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
theirs: Now upon the first [day] of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain [others] with them.

ours: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
theirs: And as they were afraid, and bowed down [their] faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?

ours: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
theirs: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary [the mother] of James, and other [women that were] with them, which told these things unto the apostles.

ours: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
theirs: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem [about] threescore furlongs.

ours: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
theirs: And it came to pass, that, while they communed [together] and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

ours: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
theirs: And he said unto them, What manner of communications [are] these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?

ours: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
theirs: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found [it] even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.

ours: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
theirs: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed [it], and brake, and gave to them.

ours: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
theirs: And they told what things [were done] in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.

ours: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
theirs: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace [be] unto you.

ours: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
theirs: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them [his] hands and [his] feet.

ours: And he took it, and did eat before them.
theirs: And he took [it], and did eat before them.

ours: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
theirs: And he said unto them, These [are] the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and [in] the prophets, and [in] the psalms, concerning me.

ours: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
theirs: There was a man sent from God, whose name [was] John.

ours: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
theirs: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all [men] through him might believe.

ours: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
theirs: He was not that Light, but [was sent] to bear witness of that Light.

ours: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
theirs: [That] was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

ours: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
theirs: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, [even] to them that believe on his name:

ours: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
theirs: For the law was given by Moses, [but] grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

ours: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
theirs: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared [him].

ours: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
theirs: He said, I [am] the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

ours: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoes latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
theirs: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

ours: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peters brother.
theirs: One of the two which heard John [speak], and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

ours: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
theirs: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do [it].

ours: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
theirs: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare [it].

ours: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
theirs: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: [but] thou hast kept the good wine until now.

ours: And the Jews passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
theirs: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,

ours: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers money, and overthrew the tables;
theirs: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;

ours: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Fathers house an house of merchandise.
theirs: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.

ours: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
theirs: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast [day], many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

ours: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
theirs: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all [men],

ours: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mothers womb, and be born?
theirs: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

ours: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
theirs: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and [of] the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

ours: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
theirs: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you [of] heavenly things?

ours: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
theirs: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, [even] the Son of man which is in heaven.

ours: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
theirs: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

ours: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
theirs: And John also was baptizing in AEnon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

ours: Then there arose a question between some of Johns disciples and the Jews about purifying.
theirs: Then there arose a question between [some] of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.

ours: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
theirs: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all [men] come to him.

ours: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegrooms voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
theirs: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

ours: He must increase, but I must decrease.
theirs: He must increase, but I [must] decrease.

ours: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
theirs: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure [unto him].

ours: He left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.
theirs: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.

ours: Now Jacobs well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
theirs: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with [his] journey, sat thus on the well: [and] it was about the sixth hour.

ours: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
theirs: God [is] a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship [him] in spirit and in truth.

ours: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
theirs: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am [he].

ours: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
theirs: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him [ought] to eat?

ours: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
theirs: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and [then] cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

ours: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
theirs: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard [him] ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

ours: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
theirs: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

ours: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
theirs: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

ours: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
theirs: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told [him], saying, Thy son liveth.

ours: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
theirs: So the father knew that [it was] at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

ours: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judæa into Galilee.
theirs: This [is] again the second miracle [that] Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.

ours: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
theirs: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep [market] a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

ours: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
theirs: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time [in that case], he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

ours: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
theirs: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry [thy] bed.

ours: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
theirs: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in [that] place.

ours: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
theirs: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth [them]; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

ours: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
theirs: That all [men] should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

ours: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
theirs: But I have greater witness than [that] of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

ours: I am come in my Fathers name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
theirs: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

ours: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
theirs: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that [cometh] from God only?

ours: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
theirs: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is [one] that accuseth you, [even] Moses, in whom ye trust.

ours: AFTER these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
theirs: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is [the sea] of Tiberias.

ours: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
theirs: When Jesus then lifted up [his] eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

ours: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peters brother, saith unto him,
theirs: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,

ours: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
theirs: Therefore they gathered [them] together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

ours: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
theirs: And when even was [now] come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

ours: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
theirs: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but [that] his disciples were gone away alone;

ours: And this is the Fathers will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
theirs: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

ours: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
theirs: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us [his] flesh to eat?

ours: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
theirs: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard [this], said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

ours: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
theirs: [What] and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

ours: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
theirs: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, [they] are spirit, and [they] are life.

ours: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
theirs: From that [time] many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

ours: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
theirs: He spake of Judas Iscariot [the son] of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

ours: Now the Jews feast of tabernacles was at hand.
theirs: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.

ours: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
theirs: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

ours: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
theirs: For [there is] no man [that] doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

ours: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
theirs: When he had said these words unto them, he abode [still] in Galilee.

ours: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
theirs: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or [whether] I speak of myself.

ours: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
theirs: Did not Moses give you the law, and [yet] none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

ours: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
theirs: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this [man] hath done?

ours: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
theirs: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and [then] I go unto him that sent me.

ours: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
theirs: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find [me]: and where I am, [thither] ye cannot come.

ours: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
theirs: What [manner of] saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find [me]: and where I am, [thither] ye cannot come?

ours: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
theirs: In the last day, that great [day] of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

ours: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
theirs: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet [given]; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

ours: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
theirs: Doth our law judge [any] man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

ours: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
theirs: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with [his] finger wrote on the ground, [as though he heard them not].

ours: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
theirs: And they which heard [it], being convicted by [their own] conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, [even] unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

ours: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
theirs: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, [yet] my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

ours: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
theirs: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am [he], ye shall die in your sins.

ours: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
theirs: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even [the same] that I said unto you from the beginning.

ours: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
theirs: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am [he], and [that] I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

ours: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
theirs: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, [then] are ye my disciples indeed;

ours: They answered him, We be Abrahams seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
theirs: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

ours: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
theirs: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: [but] the Son abideth ever.

ours: I know that ye are Abrahams seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
theirs: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

ours: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abrahams children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
theirs: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

ours: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
theirs: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, [even] God.

ours: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
theirs: Why do ye not understand my speech? [even] because ye cannot hear my word.

ours: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
theirs: Ye are of [your] father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

ours: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
theirs: And because I tell [you] the truth, ye believe me not.

ours: He that is of God heareth Gods words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
theirs: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear [them] not, because ye are not of God.

ours: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
theirs: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw [it], and was glad.

ours: AND as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
theirs: And as [Jesus] passed by, he saw a man which was blind from [his] birth.

ours: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
theirs: Some said, This is he: others [said], He is like him: [but] he said, I am [he].

ours: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
theirs: These [words] spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

ours: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
theirs: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner [or no], I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

ours: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
theirs: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear [it] again? will ye also be his disciples?

ours: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses disciples.
theirs: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

ours: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
theirs: We know that God spake unto Moses: [as for] this [fellow], we know not from whence he is.

ours: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
theirs: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and [yet] he hath opened mine eyes.

ours: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
theirs: And [some] of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

ours: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
theirs: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have [it] more abundantly.

ours: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
theirs: I am the good shepherd, and know my [sheep], and am known of mine.

ours: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
theirs: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, [and] one shepherd.

ours: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomons porch.
theirs: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

ours: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Fathers name, they bear witness of me.
theirs: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.

ours: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
theirs: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any [man] pluck them out of my hand.

ours: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Fathers hand.
theirs: My Father, which gave [them] me, is greater than all; and no [man] is able to pluck [them] out of my Father's hand.

ours: I and my Father are one.
theirs: I and [my] Father are one.

ours: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
theirs: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father [is] in me, and I in him.

ours: NOW a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
theirs: Now a certain [man] was sick, [named] Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

ours: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
theirs: (It was [that] Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

ours: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
theirs: When Jesus heard [that], he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
