ours: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.
theirs: Then after that saith he to [his] disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

ours: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
theirs: [His] disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?

ours: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
theirs: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had [lain] in the grave four days already.

ours: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
theirs: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat [still] in the house.

ours: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
theirs: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give [it] thee.

ours: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
theirs: As soon as she heard [that], she arose quickly, and came unto him.

ours: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
theirs: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been [dead] four days.

ours: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
theirs: Then they took away the stone [from the place] where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up [his] eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

ours: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
theirs: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said [it], that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

ours: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
theirs: If we let him thus alone, all [men] will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

ours: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
theirs: And one of them, [named] Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

ours: And the Jews passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
theirs: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

ours: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
theirs: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew [it], that they might take him.

ours: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simons son, which should betray him,
theirs: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's [son], which should betray him,

ours: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
theirs: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

ours: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
theirs: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed [is] the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

ours: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an asss colt.
theirs: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.

ours: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
theirs: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and [that] they had done these things unto him.

ours: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
theirs: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will [my] Father honour.

ours: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
theirs: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, [saying], I have both glorified [it], and will glorify [it] again.

ours: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
theirs: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard [it], said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

ours: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
theirs: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all [men] unto me.

ours: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
theirs: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with [their] eyes, nor understand with [their] heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

ours: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
theirs: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess [him], lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

ours: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simons son, to betray him;
theirs: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's [son], to betray him;

ours: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
theirs: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe [them] with the towel wherewith he was girded.

ours: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
theirs: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also [my] hands and [my] head.

ours: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
theirs: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash [his] feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

ours: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
theirs: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for [so] I am.

ours: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one anothers feet.
theirs: If I then, [your] Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

ours: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
theirs: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am [he].

ours: Now there was leaning on Jesus bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
theirs: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

ours: He then lying on Jesus breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
theirs: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

ours: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
theirs: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped [it]. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave [it] to Judas Iscariot, [the son] of Simon.

ours: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
theirs: For some [of them] thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy [those things] that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

ours: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
theirs: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

ours: In my Fathers house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
theirs: In my Father's house are many mansions: if [it were] not [so], I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

ours: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
theirs: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, [there] ye may be also.

ours: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
theirs: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou [then], Shew us the Father?

ours: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works sake.
theirs: Believe me that I [am] in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

ours: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
theirs: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater [works] than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

ours: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
theirs: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do [it].

ours: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
theirs: [Even] the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

ours: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
theirs: At that day ye shall know that I [am] in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

ours: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Fathers which sent me.
theirs: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

ours: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
theirs: These things have I spoken unto you, being [yet] present with you.

ours: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
theirs: But the Comforter, [which is] the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

ours: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
theirs: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come [again] unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

ours: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
theirs: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every [branch] that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

ours: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
theirs: I am the vine, ye [are] the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

ours: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
theirs: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast [them] into the fire, and they are burned.

ours: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Fathers commandments, and abide in his love.
theirs: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

ours: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
theirs: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and [that] your joy might be full.

ours: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
theirs: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and [that] your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

ours: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
theirs: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before [it hated] you.

ours: But all these things will they do unto you for my names sake, because they know not him that sent me.
theirs: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

ours: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
theirs: But [this cometh to pass], that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

ours: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
theirs: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, [even] the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

ours: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
theirs: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, [that] shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

ours: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
theirs: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew [it] unto you.

ours: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
theirs: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew [it] unto you.

ours: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
theirs: Then said [some] of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

ours: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
theirs: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give [it] you.

ours: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
theirs: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received [them], and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

ours: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
theirs: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we [are].

ours: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
theirs: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, [art] in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

ours: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
theirs: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare [it]: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

ours: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
theirs: Judas then, having received a band [of men] and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

ours: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
theirs: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am [he]. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

ours: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
theirs: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am [he], they went backward, and fell to the ground.

ours: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
theirs: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am [he]: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

ours: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priests servant, and cut off his right ear. The servants name was Malchus.
theirs: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

ours: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
theirs: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and [so did] another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

ours: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this mans disciples? He saith, I am not.
theirs: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also [one] of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.

ours: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
theirs: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also [one] of his disciples? He denied [it], and said, I am not.

ours: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
theirs: One of the servants of the high priest, being [his] kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

ours: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
theirs: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault [at all].

ours: THEN Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
theirs: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged [him].

ours: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
theirs: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put [it] on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

ours: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
theirs: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And [Pilate] saith unto them, Behold the man!

ours: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
theirs: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify [him], crucify [him]. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify [him]: for I find no fault in him.

ours: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
theirs: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power [at all] against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

ours: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cæsars friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cæsar.
theirs: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

ours: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cæsar.
theirs: But they cried out, Away with [him], away with [him], crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.

ours: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
theirs: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led [him] away.

ours: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
theirs: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called [the place] of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

ours: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
theirs: And Pilate wrote a title, and put [it] on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

ours: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
theirs: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, [and] Greek, [and] Latin.

ours: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
theirs: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also [his] coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

ours: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mothers sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
theirs: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the [wife] of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

ours: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
theirs: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own [home].

ours: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
theirs: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put [it] upon hyssop, and put [it] to his mouth.

ours: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
theirs: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and [that] they might be taken away.

ours: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
theirs: And he that saw [it] bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.

ours: And after this Joseph of Arimathæa, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
theirs: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave [him] leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

ours: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
theirs: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound [weight].

ours: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
theirs: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation [day]; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

ours: THE first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
theirs: The first [day] of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

ours: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
theirs: And he stooping down, [and looking in], saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

ours: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
theirs: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, [and looked] into the sepulchre,

ours: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
theirs: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and [to] my God, and your God.

ours: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
theirs: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and [that] he had spoken these things unto her.

ours: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
theirs: Then the same day at evening, being the first [day] of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace [be] unto you.

ours: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
theirs: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them [his] hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

ours: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
theirs: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace [be] unto you: as [my] Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

ours: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
theirs: And when he had said this, he breathed on [them], and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

ours: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
theirs: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; [and] whose soever [sins] ye retain, they are retained.

ours: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
theirs: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: [then] came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace [be] unto you.

ours: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
theirs: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust [it] into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

ours: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
theirs: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed [are] they that have not seen, and [yet] have believed.

ours: AFTER these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
theirs: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he [himself].

ours: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
theirs: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the [sons] of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

ours: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fishers coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
theirs: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt [his] fisher's coat [unto him], (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

ours: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
theirs: Jesus saith unto them, Come [and] dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

ours: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
theirs: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, [son] of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

ours: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
theirs: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, [son] of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

ours: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
theirs: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, [son] of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

ours: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
theirs: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry [thee] whither thou wouldest not.

ours: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
theirs: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what [shall] this man [do]?

ours: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
theirs: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what [is that] to thee? follow thou me.

ours: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
theirs: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what [is that] to thee?

ours: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
theirs: And, being assembled together with [them], commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, [saith he], ye have heard of me.

ours: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
theirs: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

ours: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath days journey.
theirs: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.

ours: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
theirs: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James [the son] of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas [the brother] of James.

ours: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
theirs: Men [and] brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.

ours: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
theirs: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all [men], shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,

ours: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilæans?
theirs: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?

ours: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judæa, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
theirs: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

ours: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judæa, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
theirs: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all [ye] that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

ours: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
theirs: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is [but] the third hour of the day.

ours: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
theirs: And it shall come to pass, [that] whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

ours: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
theirs: Men [and] brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.

ours: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
theirs: Now when they heard [this], they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men [and] brethren, what shall we do?

ours: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
theirs: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, [even] as many as the Lord our God shall call.

ours: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
theirs: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added [unto them] about three thousand souls.

ours: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
theirs: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

ours: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
theirs: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all [men], as every man had need.

ours: NOW Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
theirs: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, [being] the ninth [hour].

ours: And a certain man lame from his mothers womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
theirs: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

ours: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ancle bones received strength.
theirs: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted [him] up: and immediately his feet and ancle bones received strength.

ours: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomons, greatly wondering.
theirs: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

ours: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
theirs: And when Peter saw [it], he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

ours: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.
theirs: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let [him] go.

ours: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
theirs: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did [it], as [did] also your rulers.

ours: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
theirs: And it shall come to pass, [that] every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

ours: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
theirs: And they laid hands on them, and put [them] in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.

ours: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
theirs: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, [even] by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

ours: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
theirs: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them [is] manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny [it].

ours: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
theirs: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all [men] glorified God for that which was done.

ours: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
theirs: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou [art] God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

ours: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
theirs: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any [of them] that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

ours: And laid them down at the apostles feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
theirs: And laid [them] down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

ours: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
theirs: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, [and] of the country of Cyprus,

ours: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles feet.
theirs: Having land, sold [it], and brought the money, and laid [it] at the apostles' feet.

ours: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles feet.
theirs: And kept back [part] of the price, his wife also being privy [to it], and brought a certain part, and laid [it] at the apostles' feet.

ours: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
theirs: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back [part] of the price of the land?

ours: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
theirs: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried [him] out, and buried [him].

ours: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
theirs: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband [are] at the door, and shall carry thee out.

ours: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
theirs: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying [her] forth, buried [her] by her husband.

ours: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomons porch.
theirs: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

ours: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
theirs: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid [them] on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

ours: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
theirs: There came also a multitude [out] of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

ours: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
theirs: And when they heard [that], they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

ours: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
theirs: And when they had brought them, they set [them] before the council: and the high priest asked them,

ours: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this mans blood upon us.
theirs: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.

ours: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
theirs: Then Peter and the [other] apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

ours: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
theirs: Him hath God exalted with his right hand [to be] a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

ours: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
theirs: And we are his witnesses of these things; and [so is] also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

ours: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
theirs: When they heard [that], they were cut [to the heart], and took counsel to slay them.

ours: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
theirs: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, [even] as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

ours: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
theirs: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten [them], they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

ours: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
theirs: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples [unto them], and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

ours: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
theirs: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid [their] hands on them.

ours: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
theirs: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called [the synagogue] of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

ours: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
theirs: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and [against] God.

ours: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
theirs: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon [him], and caught him, and brought [him] to the council,

ours: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldæans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
theirs: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.

ours: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
theirs: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not [so much as] to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when [as yet] he had no child.

ours: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
theirs: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat [them] evil four hundred years.

ours: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
theirs: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so [Abraham] begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac [begat] Jacob; and Jacob [begat] the twelve patriarchs.

ours: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Josephs kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
theirs: And at the second [time] Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.

ours: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
theirs: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to [him], and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.

ours: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
theirs: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor [the father] of Sychem.

ours: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his fathers house three months:
theirs: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:

ours: And when he was cast out, Pharaohs daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
theirs: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

ours: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
theirs: And seeing one [of them] suffer wrong, he defended [him], and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

ours: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
theirs: When Moses saw [it], he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold [it], the voice of the Lord came unto him,

ours: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
theirs: [Saying], I [am] the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

ours: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
theirs: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send [to be] a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

ours: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
theirs: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and [with] our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:

ours: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
theirs: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust [him] from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,

ours: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
theirs: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for [as for] this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

ours: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
theirs: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices [by the space of] forty years in the wilderness?

ours: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
theirs: Heaven [is] my throne, and earth [is] my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what [is] the place of my rest?

ours: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
theirs: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers [did], so [do] ye.

ours: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
theirs: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept [it].

ours: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
theirs: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with [their] teeth.

ours: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young mans feet, whose name was Saul.
theirs: And cast [him] out of the city, and stoned [him]: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.

ours: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
theirs: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon [God], and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

ours: AND Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judæa and Samaria, except the apostles.
theirs: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.

ours: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
theirs: And devout men carried Stephen [to his burial], and made great lamentation over him.

ours: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
theirs: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed [them] to prison.

ours: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
theirs: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed [with them]: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.

ours: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
theirs: Then laid they [their] hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.

ours: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
theirs: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,

ours: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
theirs: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and [in] the bond of iniquity.

ours: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
theirs: And Philip ran thither to [him], and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?

ours: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
theirs: And as they went on [their] way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, [here is] water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?

ours: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Cæsarea.
theirs: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.

ours: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
theirs: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: [it is] hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

ours: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
theirs: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord [said] unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

theirs: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and [toward] men.

ours: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
theirs: Or else let these same [here] say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,

ours: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.
theirs: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of [that] way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.

ours: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.
theirs: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let [him] have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.

ours: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.
theirs: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix' room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.

ours: NOW when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Cæsarea to Jerusalem.
theirs: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.

ours: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Cæsarea, and that he himself would depart shortly thither.
theirs: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly [thither].

ours: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.
theirs: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with [me], and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.

ours: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Cæsarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.
theirs: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.

ours: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Cæsar, have I offended any thing at all.
theirs: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.

ours: Then said Paul, I stand at Cæsars judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.
theirs: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.

ours: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Cæsar.
theirs: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.

ours: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Cæsar? unto Cæsar shalt thou go.
theirs: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.

ours: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Cæsarea to salute Festus.
theirs: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.

ours: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Pauls cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:
theirs: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:

ours: About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, desiring to have judgment against him.
theirs: About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed [me], desiring [to have] judgment against him.

ours: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.
theirs: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked [him] whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.

ours: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Cæsar.
theirs: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.

ours: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus commandment Paul was brought forth.
theirs: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.

ours: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and also here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.
theirs: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and [also] here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

ours: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.
theirs: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes [laid] against him.

ours: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.
theirs: Especially [because I know] thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.

ours: Unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come. For which hopes sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.
theirs: Unto which [promise] our twelve tribes, instantly serving [God] day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.

ours: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against them.
theirs: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against [them].

ours: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted them even unto strange cities.
theirs: And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled [them] to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted [them] even unto strange cities.

ours: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
theirs: And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? [it is] hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

ours: Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,
theirs: Delivering thee from the people, and [from] the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,

ours: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.
theirs: To open their eyes, [and] to turn [them] from darkness to light, and [from] the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.

ours: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judæa, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.
theirs: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judaea, and [then] to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.

ours: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill me.
theirs: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill [me].

ours: That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.
theirs: That Christ should suffer, [and] that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.

ours: Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Cæsar.
theirs: Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Caesar.

ours: AND when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus band.
theirs: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto [one] named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.

ours: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.
theirs: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; [one] Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.

ours: And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.
theirs: And the next [day] we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave [him] liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.

ours: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.
theirs: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, [a city] of Lycia.

ours: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.
theirs: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city [of] Lasea.

ours: Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished them,
theirs: Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished [them],

ours: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, and there to winter; which is an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.
theirs: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, [and there] to winter; [which is] an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.

ours: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.
theirs: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained [their] purpose, loosing [thence], they sailed close by Crete.

ours: And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let her drive.
theirs: And when the ship was caught, and could not bear up into the wind, we let [her] drive.

ours: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next day they lightened the ship;
theirs: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next [day] they lightened the ship;

ours: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.
theirs: And the third [day] we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.

ours: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
theirs: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on [us], all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.

ours: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any mans life among you, but of the ship.
theirs: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of [any man's] life among you, but of the ship.

ours: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Cæsar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.
theirs: Saying, Fear not, Paul; thou must be brought before Caesar: and, lo, God hath given thee all them that sail with thee.

ours: And sounded, and found it twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found it fifteen fathoms.
theirs: And sounded, and found [it] twenty fathoms: and when they had gone a little further, they sounded again, and found [it] fifteen fathoms.

ours: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought them all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.
theirs: And while the day was coming on, Paul besought [them] all to take meat, saying, This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting, having taken nothing.

ours: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.
theirs: Wherefore I pray you to take [some] meat: for this is for your health: for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you.

ours: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken it, he began to eat.
theirs: And when he had thus spoken, he took bread, and gave thanks to God in presence of them all: and when he had broken [it], he began to eat.

ours: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.
theirs: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took [some] meat.

ours: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.
theirs: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed [themselves] unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.

ours: And the soldiers counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.
theirs: And the soldiers' counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.

ours: But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from their purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea, and get to land:
theirs: But the centurion, willing to save Paul, kept them from [their] purpose; and commanded that they which could swim should cast [themselves] first [into the sea], and get to land:

ours: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.
theirs: And the rest, some on boards, and some on [broken pieces] of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.

ours: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
theirs: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid [them] on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.

ours: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.
theirs: And when the barbarians saw the [venomous] beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.

ours: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.
theirs: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded [us] with such things as were necessary.

ours: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.
theirs: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried [there] three days.

ours: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.
theirs: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men [and] brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.

ours: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.
theirs: Who, when they had examined me, would have let [me] go, because there was no cause of death in me.

ours: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Cæsar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.
