theirs: But when the Jews spake against [it], I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.

ours: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.
theirs: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see [you], and to speak with [you]: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.

ours: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judæa concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.
theirs: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.

ours: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.
theirs: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into [his] lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and [out of] the prophets, from morning till evening.

ours: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
theirs: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with [their] eyes, and hear with [their] ears, and understand with [their] heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

ours: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.
theirs: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and [that] they will hear it.

ours: PAUL, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
theirs: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called [to be] an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

ours: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
theirs: And declared [to be] the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:

ours: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
theirs: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called [to be] saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ours: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
theirs: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed [it] unto them.

ours: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
theirs: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, [even] his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

ours: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
theirs: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified [him] not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

ours: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
theirs: And even as they did not like to retain God in [their] knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

ours: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
theirs: (For not the hearers of the law [are] just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

ours: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
theirs: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and [their] thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)

ours: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
theirs: And knowest [his] will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;

ours: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
theirs: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither [is that] circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

ours: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
theirs: But he [is] a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision [is that] of the heart, in the spirit, [and] not in the letter; whose praise [is] not of men, but of God.

ours: WHAT advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
theirs: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit [is there] of circumcision?

ours: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
theirs: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? [Is] God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

ours: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
theirs: And not [rather], (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

ours: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
theirs: What then? are we better [than they]? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;

ours: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
theirs: Their throat [is] an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps [is] under their lips:

ours: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
theirs: Whose mouth [is] full of cursing and bitterness:

ours: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
theirs: Their feet [are] swift to shed blood:

ours: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
theirs: Destruction and misery [are] in their ways:

ours: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
theirs: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law [is] the knowledge of sin.

ours: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
theirs: Even the righteousness of God [which is] by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

ours: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
theirs: Whom God hath set forth [to be] a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;

ours: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
theirs: To declare, [I say], at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.

ours: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
theirs: Where [is] boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

ours: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
theirs: [Is he] the God of the Jews only? [is he] not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

ours: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
theirs: Seeing [it is] one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

ours: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
theirs: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath [whereof] to glory; but not before God.

ours: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
theirs: [Saying], Blessed [are] they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

ours: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
theirs: Blessed [is] the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

ours: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
theirs: [Cometh] this blessedness then upon the circumcision [only], or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.

ours: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
theirs: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which [he had yet] being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

ours: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
theirs: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which [he had] being [yet] uncircumcised.

ours: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
theirs: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, [was] not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

ours: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
theirs: For if they which are of the law [be] heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

ours: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
theirs: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, [there is] no transgression.

ours: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
theirs: Therefore [it is] of faith, that [it might be] by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

ours: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
theirs: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, [even] God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

ours: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Saras womb:
theirs: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:

ours: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
theirs: And not only [so], but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;

ours: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
theirs: And not only [so], but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.

ours: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adams transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
theirs: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

ours: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
theirs: But not as the offence, so also [is] the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, [which is] by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

ours: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
theirs: And not as [it was] by one that sinned, [so is] the gift: for the judgment [was] by one to condemnation, but the free gift [is] of many offences unto justification.

ours: For if by one mans offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
theirs: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)

ours: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
theirs: Therefore as by the offence of one [judgment came] upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one [the free gift came] upon all men unto justification of life.

ours: For as by one mans disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
theirs: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

ours: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
theirs: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also [in the likeness] of [his] resurrection:

ours: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
theirs: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with [him], that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

ours: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
theirs: Neither yield ye your members [as] instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members [as] instruments of righteousness unto God.

ours: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
theirs: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things [is] death.

ours: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
theirs: For the wages of sin [is] death; but the gift of God [is] eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

ours: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
theirs: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to [her] husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of [her] husband.

ours: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
theirs: So then if, while [her] husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

ours: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
theirs: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, [even] to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.

ours: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
theirs: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not [in] the oldness of the letter.

ours: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
theirs: What shall we say then? [Is] the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.

ours: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
theirs: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin [was] dead.

ours: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
theirs: And the commandment, which [was ordained] to life, I found [to be] unto death.

ours: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
theirs: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew [me].

ours: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
theirs: Wherefore the law [is] holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

ours: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
theirs: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that [it is] good.

ours: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
theirs: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but [how] to perform that which is good I find not.

ours: THERE is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
theirs: [There is] therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

ours: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
theirs: For to be carnally minded [is] death; but to be spiritually minded [is] life and peace.

ours: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
theirs: Because the carnal mind [is] enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.

ours: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
theirs: And if Christ [be] in you, the body [is] dead because of sin; but the Spirit [is] life because of righteousness.

ours: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
theirs: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with [him], that we may be also glorified together.

ours: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
theirs: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time [are] not worthy [to be compared] with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

ours: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
theirs: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected [the same] in hope,

ours: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
theirs: And not only [they], but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, [to wit], the redemption of our body.

ours: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
theirs: But if we hope for that we see not, [then] do we with patience wait for [it].

ours: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
theirs: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what [is] the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to [the will of] God.

ours: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
theirs: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to [his] purpose.

ours: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
theirs: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate [to be] conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

ours: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
theirs: What shall we then say to these things? If God [be] for us, who [can be] against us?

ours: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of Gods elect? It is God that justifieth.
theirs: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? [It is] God that justifieth.

ours: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
theirs: Who [is] he that condemneth? [It is] Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

ours: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
theirs: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? [shall] tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

ours: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
theirs: Who are Israelites; to whom [pertaineth] the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service [of God], and the promises;

ours: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
theirs: Whose [are] the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ [came], who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

ours: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
theirs: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they [are] not all Israel, which are of Israel:

ours: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
theirs: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, [are they] all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

ours: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
theirs: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these [are] not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

ours: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.
theirs: For this [is] the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.

ours: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
theirs: And not only [this]; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, [even] by our father Isaac;

ours: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
theirs: (For [the children] being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)

ours: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
theirs: What shall we say then? [Is there] unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

ours: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
theirs: So then [it is] not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.

ours: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
theirs: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will [have mercy], and whom he will he hardeneth.

ours: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
theirs: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed [it], Why hast thou made me thus?

ours: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
theirs: [What] if God, willing to shew [his] wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

ours: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
theirs: And it shall come to pass, [that] in the place where it was said unto them, Ye [are] not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

ours: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
theirs: For he will finish the work, and cut [it] short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.

ours: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
theirs: Wherefore? Because [they sought it] not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;

ours: BRETHREN, my hearts desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
theirs: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

ours: For they being ignorant of Gods righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
theirs: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.

ours: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
theirs: For Christ [is] the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

ours: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
theirs: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down [from above]:)

ours: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
theirs: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, [even] in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

ours: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
theirs: So then faith [cometh] by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

ours: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
theirs: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by [them that are] no people, [and] by a foolish nation I will anger you.

ours: I SAY then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
theirs: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, [of] the tribe of Benjamin.

ours: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
theirs: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to [the image of] Baal.

ours: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
theirs: And if by grace, then [is it] no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if [it be] of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

ours: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
theirs: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but [rather] through their fall salvation [is come] unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.

ours: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
theirs: Now if the fall of them [be] the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?

ours: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
theirs: If by any means I may provoke to emulation [them which are] my flesh, and might save some of them.

ours: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
theirs: For if the casting away of them [be] the reconciling of the world, what [shall] the receiving [of them be], but life from the dead?

ours: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
theirs: For if the firstfruit [be] holy, the lump [is] also [holy]: and if the root [be] holy, so [are] the branches.

ours: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
theirs: For if God spared not the natural branches, [take heed] lest he also spare not thee.

ours: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
theirs: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in [his] goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

ours: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
theirs: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural [branches], be graffed into their own olive tree?

ours: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
theirs: For this [is] my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.

ours: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers sakes.
theirs: As concerning the gospel, [they are] enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, [they are] beloved for the fathers' sakes.

ours: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
theirs: For the gifts and calling of God [are] without repentance.

ours: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
theirs: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable [are] his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

ours: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
theirs: For of him, and through him, and to him, [are] all things: to whom [be] glory for ever. Amen.

ours: I BESEECH you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
theirs: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, [which is] your reasonable service.

ours: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
theirs: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what [is] that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

ours: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
theirs: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think [of himself] more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

ours: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
theirs: So we, [being] many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

ours: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
theirs: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, [let us prophesy] according to the proportion of faith;

ours: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
theirs: Or ministry, [let us wait] on [our] ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

ours: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
theirs: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, [let him do it] with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

ours: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
theirs: [Let] love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

ours: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
theirs: [Be] kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

ours: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
theirs: [Be] of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

ours: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
theirs: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but [rather] give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance [is] mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

ours: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
theirs: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to [execute] wrath upon him that doeth evil.

ours: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
theirs: Wherefore [ye] must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

ours: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are Gods ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
theirs: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

ours: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
theirs: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute [is due]; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

ours: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
theirs: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if [there be] any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

ours: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
theirs: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love [is] the fulfilling of the law.

ours: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
theirs: And that, knowing the time, that now [it is] high time to awake out of sleep: for now [is] our salvation nearer than when we believed.

ours: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
theirs: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to [fulfil] the lusts [thereof].

ours: HIM that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
theirs: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, [but] not to doubtful disputations.

ours: Who art thou that judgest another mans servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
theirs: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.

ours: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
theirs: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day [alike]. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

ours: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
theirs: He that regardeth the day, regardeth [it] unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard [it]. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.

ours: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lords.
theirs: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.

ours: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
theirs: For it is written, [As] I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.

ours: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brothers way.
theirs: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in [his] brother's way.

ours: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
theirs: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that [there is] nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him [it is] unclean.

ours: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
theirs: But if thy brother be grieved with [thy] meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.

ours: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
theirs: For he that in these things serveth Christ [is] acceptable to God, and approved of men.

ours: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
theirs: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed [are] pure; but [it is] evil for that man who eateth with offence.

ours: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
theirs: [It is] good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor [any thing] whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.

ours: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
theirs: Hast thou faith? have [it] to thyself before God. Happy [is] he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

ours: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
theirs: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because [he eateth] not of faith: for whatsoever [is] not of faith is sin.

ours: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
theirs: Let every one of us please [his] neighbour for [his] good to edification.

ours: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
theirs: That ye may with one mind [and] one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

ours: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
theirs: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises [made] unto the fathers:

ours: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
theirs: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for [his] mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.

ours: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another mans foundation:
theirs: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:

ours: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
theirs: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your [company].

ours: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christs sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
theirs: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in [your] prayers to God for me;

ours: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judæa; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
theirs: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which [I have] for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;

ours: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
theirs: Now the God of peace [be] with you all. Amen.

ours: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epænetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
theirs: Likewise [greet] the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

ours: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus household.
theirs: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' [household].

ours: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
theirs: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the [household] of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

ours: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
theirs: For your obedience is come abroad unto all [men]. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.

ours: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
theirs: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you. Amen.

ours: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
theirs: I Tertius, who wrote [this] epistle, salute you in the Lord.

ours: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
theirs: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you all. Amen.

ours: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
theirs: To God only wise, [be] glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen. <<[Written to the Romans from Corinthus, [and sent] by Phebe servant of the church at Cenchrea.]>>

ours: PAUL, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
theirs: Paul, called [to be] an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes [our] brother,

ours: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:
theirs: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called [to be] saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:

ours: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
theirs: Grace [be] unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and [from] the Lord Jesus Christ.

ours: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
theirs: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and [in] all knowledge;

ours: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
theirs: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, [that ye may be] blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

ours: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
theirs: God [is] faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

ours: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
theirs: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and [that] there be no divisions among you; but [that] ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

ours: For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.
theirs: For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them [which are of the house] of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.

ours: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
theirs: Where [is] the wise? where [is] the scribe? where [is] the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

ours: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:
theirs: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, [are called]:

ours: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
theirs: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, [yea], and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:

ours: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of mans wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
theirs: And my speech and my preaching [was] not with enticing words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:

ours: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which God ordained before the world unto our glory:
theirs: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, [even] the hidden [wisdom], which God ordained before the world unto our glory:

ours: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
theirs: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known [it], they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

ours: But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.
theirs: But God hath revealed [them] unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.

ours: Which things also we speak, not in the words which mans wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.
theirs: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man's wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.

ours: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
theirs: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know [them], because they are spiritually discerned.

ours: AND I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.
theirs: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, [even] as unto babes in Christ.

ours: I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto ye were not able to bear it, neither yet now are ye able.
theirs: I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto ye were not able [to bear it], neither yet now are ye able.

ours: For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?
theirs: For ye are yet carnal: for whereas [there is] among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?

ours: For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?
theirs: For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I [am] of Apollos; are ye not carnal?

ours: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?
theirs: Who then is Paul, and who [is] Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?

ours: For we are labourers together with God: ye are Gods husbandry, ye are Gods building.
theirs: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God's husbandry, [ye are] God's building.

ours: Every mans work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every mans work of what sort it is.
theirs: Every man's work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man's work of what sort it is.

ours: If any mans work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.
theirs: If any man's work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.

ours: If any mans work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
theirs: If any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.

ours: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
theirs: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and [that] the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

ours: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.
theirs: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which [temple] ye are.

ours: And ye are Christs; and Christ is Gods.
theirs: And ye are Christ's; and Christ [is] God's.

ours: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of mans judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.
theirs: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man's judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.

ours: And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.
theirs: And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and [to] Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think [of men] above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.

ours: For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it?
theirs: For who maketh thee to differ [from another]? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive [it], why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received [it]?

ours: We are fools for Christs sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye are honourable, but we are despised.
theirs: We [are] fools for Christ's sake, but ye [are] wise in Christ; we [are] weak, but ye [are] strong; ye [are] honourable, but we [are] despised.

ours: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.
theirs: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, [and are] the offscouring of all things unto this day.

ours: I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.
theirs: I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn [you].

ours: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.
theirs: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet [have ye] not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.

ours: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.
theirs: For the kingdom of God [is] not in word, but in power.

ours: What will ye? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love, and in the spirit of meekness?
theirs: What will ye? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love, and [in] the spirit of meekness?

ours: IT is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his fathers wife.
theirs: It is reported commonly [that there is] fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife.

ours: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,
theirs: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, [concerning] him that hath so done this deed,

ours: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
theirs: Your glorying [is] not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?

ours: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
theirs: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened [bread] of sincerity and truth.

ours: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you, because ye go to law one with another. Why do ye not rather take wrong? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded?
theirs: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you, because ye go to law one with another. Why do ye not rather take wrong? why do ye not rather [suffer yourselves to] be defrauded?

ours: Nay, ye do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.
theirs: Nay, ye do wrong, and defraud, and that [your] brethren.

ours: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but God shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.
theirs: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but God shall destroy both it and them. Now the body [is] not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.

ours: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ? shall I then take the members of Christ, and make them the members of an harlot? God forbid.
theirs: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ? shall I then take the members of Christ, and make [them] the members of an harlot? God forbid.

ours: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?
theirs: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost [which is] in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?

ours: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are Gods.
theirs: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.

ours: NOW concerning the things whereof ye wrote unto me: It is good for a man not to touch a woman.
theirs: Now concerning the things whereof ye wrote unto me: [It is] good for a man not to touch a woman.

ours: Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.
theirs: Nevertheless, [to avoid] fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.

ours: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.
theirs: Defraud ye not one the other, except [it be] with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.

ours: But I speak this by permission, and not of commandment.
theirs: But I speak this by permission, [and] not of commandment.

ours: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:
theirs: And unto the married I command, [yet] not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from [her] husband:

ours: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.
theirs: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to [her] husband: and let not the husband put away [his] wife.

ours: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but God hath called us to peace.
theirs: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such [cases]: but God hath called us to peace.

ours: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?
theirs: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save [thy] husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save [thy] wife?

ours: Art thou called being a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use it rather.
theirs: Art thou called [being] a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use [it] rather.

ours: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lords freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christs servant.
theirs: For he that is called in the Lord, [being] a servant, is the Lord's freeman: likewise also he that is called, [being] free, is Christ's servant.

ours: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say, that it is good for a man so to be.
theirs: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, [I say], that [it is] good for a man so to be.

ours: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;
theirs: But this I say, brethren, the time [is] short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;

ours: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passeth away.
theirs: And they that use this world, as not abusing [it]: for the fashion of this world passeth away.

ours: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.
theirs: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please [his] wife.

ours: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
theirs: There is difference [also] between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please [her] husband.

ours: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.
theirs: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of [her] age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.

ours: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better.
theirs: So then he that giveth [her] in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth [her] not in marriage doeth better.

ours: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.
theirs: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol [is] nothing in the world, and that [there is] none other God but one.

ours: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
theirs: But to us [there is but] one God, the Father, of whom [are] all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom [are] all things, and we by him.

ours: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.
theirs: Howbeit [there is] not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat [it] as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.

ours: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idols temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;
theirs: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol's temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;

ours: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?
theirs: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and [as] the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?

ours: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
theirs: Or saith he [it] altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, [this] is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.

ours: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?
theirs: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, [is it] a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?

ours: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.
theirs: If others be partakers of [this] power over you, [are] not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

ours: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?
theirs: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live [of the things] of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?

ours: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.
theirs: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for [it were] better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.

ours: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.
theirs: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation [of the gospel] is committed unto me.

ours: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.
theirs: What is my reward then? [Verily] that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.

ours: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.
theirs: For though I be free from all [men], yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.

ours: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.
theirs: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all [men], that I might by all means save some.

ours: And this I do for the gospels sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.
theirs: And this I do for the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker thereof with [you].

ours: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
theirs: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they [do it] to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

ours: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
theirs: But I keep under my body, and bring [it] into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.

ours: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
theirs: Neither be ye idolaters, as [were] some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

ours: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
theirs: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God [is] faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear [it].

ours: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
theirs: For we [being] many are one bread, [and] one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

ours: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
theirs: But [I say], that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.

ours: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lords table, and of the table of devils.
theirs: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.

ours: Let no man seek his own, but every man anothers wealth.
theirs: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's [wealth].

ours: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
theirs: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, [that] eat, asking no question for conscience sake:

ours: For the earth is the Lords, and the fulness thereof.
theirs: For the earth [is] the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.

ours: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
theirs: If any of them that believe not bid you [to a feast], and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.

ours: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lords, and the fulness thereof:
theirs: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth [is] the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:

ours: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another mans conscience?
theirs: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another [man's] conscience?

ours: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
theirs: Even as I please all [men] in all [things], not seeking mine own profit, but the [profit] of many, that they may be saved.

ours: BE ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
theirs: Be ye followers of me, even as I also [am] of Christ.

ours: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
theirs: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered [them] to you.

ours: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
theirs: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman [is] the man; and the head of Christ [is] God.

ours: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
theirs: Every man praying or prophesying, having [his] head covered, dishonoureth his head.

ours: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
theirs: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with [her] head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

ours: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
theirs: For a man indeed ought not to cover [his] head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

ours: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
theirs: For this cause ought the woman to have power on [her] head because of the angels.

ours: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
theirs: For as the woman [is] of the man, even so [is] the man also by the woman; but all things of God.

ours: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
theirs: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for [her] hair is given her for a covering.

ours: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
theirs: Now in this that I declare [unto you] I praise [you] not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.

ours: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lords supper.
theirs: When ye come together therefore into one place, [this] is not to eat the Lord's supper.

ours: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
theirs: For in eating every one taketh before [other] his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.

ours: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
theirs: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise [you] not.

ours: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
theirs: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the [same] night in which he was betrayed took bread:

ours: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
theirs: And when he had given thanks, he brake [it], and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.

ours: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
theirs: After the same manner also [he took] the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink [it], in remembrance of me.

ours: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lords death till he come.
theirs: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.

ours: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
theirs: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink [this] cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

ours: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
theirs: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of [that] bread, and drink of [that] cup.

ours: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lords body.
theirs: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.

ours: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
theirs: For this cause many [are] weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.

ours: NOW concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
theirs: Now concerning spiritual [gifts], brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

ours: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
theirs: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and [that] no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.

ours: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
theirs: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another [divers] kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:

ours: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
theirs: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also [is] Christ.
