ours: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
theirs: And truly, if they had been mindful of that [country] from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

ours: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
theirs: But now they desire a better [country], that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

ours: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
theirs: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten [son],

ours: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
theirs: Accounting that God [was] able to raise [him] up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.

ours: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
theirs: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, [leaning] upon the top of his staff.

ours: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the kings commandment.
theirs: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw [he was] a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.

ours: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaohs daughter;
theirs: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;

ours: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
theirs: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry [land]: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.

ours: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
theirs: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and [of] Barak, and [of] Samson, and [of] Jephthae; [of] David also, and Samuel, and [of] the prophets:

ours: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
theirs: And others had trial of [cruel] mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

ours: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
theirs: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and [in] mountains, and [in] dens and caves of the earth.

ours: WHEREFORE seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
theirs: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset [us], and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

ours: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
theirs: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of [our] faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

ours: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
theirs: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected [us], and we gave [them] reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

ours: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
theirs: For they verily for a few days chastened [us] after their own pleasure; but he for [our] profit, that [we] might be partakers of his holiness.

ours: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
theirs: Follow peace with all [men], and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

ours: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
theirs: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble [you], and thereby many be defiled;

ours: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
theirs: Lest there [be] any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

ours: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
theirs: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which [voice] they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:

ours: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
theirs: And so terrible was the sight, [that] Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

ours: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
theirs: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than [that of] Abel.

ours: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
theirs: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more [shall not] we [escape], if we turn away from him that [speaketh] from heaven:

ours: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
theirs: And this [word], Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

ours: For our God is a consuming fire.
theirs: For our God [is] a consuming fire.

ours: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
theirs: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; [and] them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

ours: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
theirs: Marriage [is] honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

ours: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
theirs: [Let your] conversation [be] without covetousness; [and be] content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

ours: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
theirs: So that we may boldly say, The Lord [is] my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

ours: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
theirs: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of [their] conversation.

ours: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
theirs: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For [it is] a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.

ours: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
theirs: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of [our] lips giving thanks to his name.

ours: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
theirs: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that [is] unprofitable for you.

ours: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
theirs: But I beseech [you] the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

ours: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
theirs: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom [be] glory for ever and ever. Amen.

ours: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
theirs: Know ye that [our] brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

ours: Grace be with you all. Amen.
theirs: Grace [be] with you all. Amen. <<[Written to the Hebrews from Italy by Timothy.]>>

ours: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
theirs: Knowing [this], that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

ours: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
theirs: But let patience have [her] perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

ours: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
theirs: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

ours: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
theirs: A double minded man [is] unstable in all his ways.

ours: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
theirs: Blessed [is] the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

ours: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
theirs: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth [therein], he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

ours: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this mans religion is vain.
theirs: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion [is] vain.

ours: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
theirs: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, [and] to keep himself unspotted from the world.

ours: MY brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
theirs: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, [the Lord] of glory, with respect of persons.

ours: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
theirs: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one [point], he is guilty of all.

ours: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
theirs: What [doth it] profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?

ours: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
theirs: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be [ye] warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what [doth it] profit?

ours: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
theirs: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent [them] out another way?

ours: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
theirs: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same [is] a perfect man, [and] able also to bridle the whole body.

ours: Behold, we put bits in the horses mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
theirs: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.

ours: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
theirs: Behold also the ships, which though [they be] so great, and [are] driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.

ours: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
theirs: And the tongue [is] a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.

ours: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
theirs: But the tongue can no man tame; [it is] an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.

ours: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
theirs: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet [water] and bitter?

ours: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
theirs: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so [can] no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.

ours: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
theirs: Who [is] a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.

ours: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
theirs: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but [is] earthly, sensual, devilish.

ours: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
theirs: For where envying and strife [is], there [is] confusion and every evil work.

ours: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
theirs: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, [and] easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

ours: FROM whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
theirs: From whence [come] wars and fightings among you? [come they] not hence, [even] of your lusts that war in your members?

ours: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
theirs: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume [it] upon your lusts.

ours: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
theirs: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse [your] hands, [ye] sinners; and purify [your] hearts, [ye] double minded.

ours: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
theirs: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and [your] joy to heaviness.

ours: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
theirs: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of [his] brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

ours: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
theirs: Whereas ye know not what [shall be] on the morrow. For what [is] your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.

ours: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
theirs: For that ye [ought] to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.

ours: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
theirs: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth [it] not, to him it is sin.

ours: GO to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
theirs: Go to now, [ye] rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon [you].

ours: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
theirs: Ye have condemned [and] killed the just; [and] he doth not resist you.

ours: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
theirs: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and [your] nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.

ours: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
theirs: Confess [your] faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

ours: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
theirs: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

ours: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
theirs: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see [him] not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

ours: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
theirs: Receiving the end of your faith, [even] the salvation of [your] souls.

ours: Of which salvation the prophets have inquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
theirs: Of which salvation the prophets have inquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace [that should come] unto you:

ours: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every mans work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
theirs: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning [here] in fear:

ours: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
theirs: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, [as] silver and gold, from your vain conversation [received] by tradition from your fathers;

ours: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
theirs: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, [see that ye] love one another with a pure heart fervently:

ours: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
theirs: For all flesh [is] as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:

ours: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
theirs: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord [is] gracious.

ours: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
theirs: To whom coming, [as unto] a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, [and] precious,

ours: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
theirs: Unto you therefore which believe [he is] precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,

ours: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
theirs: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, [even to them] which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.

ours: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
theirs: But ye [are] a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

ours: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
theirs: Which in time past [were] not a people, but [are] now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

ours: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
theirs: Dearly beloved, I beseech [you] as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

ours: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
theirs: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by [your] good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

ours: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lords sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
theirs: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

ours: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.
theirs: As free, and not using [your] liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.

ours: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
theirs: Honour all [men]. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.

ours: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
theirs: Servants, [be] subject to [your] masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

ours: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
theirs: For this [is] thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.

ours: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
theirs: For what glory [is it], if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer [for it], ye take it patiently, this [is] acceptable with God.

ours: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
theirs: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed [himself] to him that judgeth righteously:

ours: LIKEWISE, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
theirs: Likewise, ye wives, [be] in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;

ours: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
theirs: While they behold your chaste conversation [coupled] with fear.

ours: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
theirs: Whose adorning let it not be that outward [adorning] of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;

ours: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
theirs: But [let it be] the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, [even the ornament] of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

ours: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
theirs: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with [them] according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.

ours: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
theirs: Finally, [be ye] all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, [be] pitiful, [be] courteous:

ours: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
theirs: For the eyes of the Lord [are] over the righteous, and his ears [are open] unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord [is] against them that do evil.

ours: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
theirs: And who [is] he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?

ours: But and if ye suffer for righteousness sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
theirs: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy [are ye]: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;

ours: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
theirs: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and [be] ready always to [give] an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

ours: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
theirs: For [it is] better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

ours: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
theirs: The like figure whereunto [even] baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

ours: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
theirs: That he no longer should live the rest of [his] time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

ours: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
theirs: For the time past of [our] life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

ours: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
theirs: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with [them] to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of [you]:

ours: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
theirs: As every man hath received the gift, [even so] minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

ours: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
theirs: If any man speak, [let him speak] as the oracles of God; if any man minister, [let him do it] as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

ours: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christs sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
theirs: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

ours: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
theirs: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy [are ye]; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

ours: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other mens matters.
theirs: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or [as] a thief, or [as] an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.

ours: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
theirs: Yet if [any man suffer] as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

ours: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
theirs: For the time [is come] that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if [it] first [begin] at us, what shall the end [be] of them that obey not the gospel of God?

ours: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
theirs: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls [to him] in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

ours: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
theirs: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight [thereof], not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

ours: Neither as being lords over Gods heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
theirs: Neither as being lords over [God's] heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.

ours: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
theirs: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all [of you] be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

ours: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
theirs: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle [you].

ours: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
theirs: To him [be] glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

ours: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
theirs: The [church that is] at Babylon, elected together with [you], saluteth you; and [so doth] Marcus my son.

ours: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
theirs: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace [be] with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

ours: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
theirs: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that [pertain] unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

ours: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
theirs: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make [you that ye shall] neither [be] barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

ours: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
theirs: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know [them], and be established in the present truth.

ours: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
theirs: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting [you] in remembrance;

ours: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
theirs: Knowing that shortly I must put off [this] my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

ours: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
theirs: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake [as they were] moved by the Holy Ghost.

ours: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
theirs: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast [them] down to hell, and delivered [them] into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

ours: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
theirs: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth [person], a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

ours: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
theirs: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned [them] with an overthrow, making [them] an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

ours: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
theirs: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed [his] righteous soul from day to day with [their] unlawful deeds;)

ours: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
theirs: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous [are they], selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

ours: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
theirs: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, [as] they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots [they are] and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;

ours: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
theirs: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam [the son] of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;

ours: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with mans voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
theirs: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.

ours: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
theirs: For when they speak great swelling [words] of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, [through much] wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.

ours: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
theirs: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known [it], to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.

ours: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
theirs: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog [is] turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

ours: THIS second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
theirs: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in [both] which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

ours: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
theirs: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as [they were] from the beginning of the creation.

ours: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
theirs: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day [is] with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

ours: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
theirs: [Seeing] then [that] all these things shall be dissolved, what manner [of persons] ought ye to be in [all] holy conversation and godliness,

ours: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
theirs: And account [that] the longsuffering of our Lord [is] salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

ours: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
theirs: As also in all [his] epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as [they do] also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

ours: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
theirs: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know [these things] before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.

ours: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
theirs: But grow in grace, and [in] the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him [be] glory both now and for ever. Amen.

ours: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
theirs: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen [it], and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

ours: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
theirs: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship [is] with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

ours: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
theirs: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us [our] sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

ours: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
theirs: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for [the sins of] the whole world.

ours: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his names sake.
theirs: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

ours: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
theirs: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him [that is] from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

ours: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
theirs: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him [that is] from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

ours: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
theirs: Love not the world, neither the things [that are] in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

ours: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
theirs: For all that [is] in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

ours: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
theirs: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would [no doubt] have continued with us: but [they went out], that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

ours: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: but he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
theirs: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: [(but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also].

ours: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
theirs: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, [even] eternal life.

ours: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
theirs: These [things] have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

ours: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brothers righteous.
theirs: Not as Cain, [who] was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

ours: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
theirs: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not [his] brother abideth in death.

ours: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
theirs: Hereby perceive we the love [of God], because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down [our] lives for the brethren.

ours: But whoso hath this worlds good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
theirs: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels [of compassion] from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?

ours: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
theirs: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, [then] have we confidence toward God.

ours: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
theirs: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that [spirit] of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

ours: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
theirs: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son [to be] the propitiation for our sins.

ours: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
theirs: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son [to be] the Saviour of the world.

ours: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
theirs: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, [even] our faith.

ours: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
theirs: This is he that came by water and blood, [even] Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

ours: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
theirs: He that hath the Son hath life; [and] he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

ours: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
theirs: If any man see his brother sin a sin [which is] not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

ours: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
theirs: [And] we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

ours: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
theirs: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, [even] in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

ours: For the truths sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
theirs: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

ours: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
theirs: Grace be with you, mercy, [and] peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

ours: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
theirs: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into [your] house, neither bid him God speed:

ours: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
theirs: Having many things to write unto you, I would not [write] with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

ours: Because that for his names sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
theirs: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

ours: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
theirs: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth [them] out of the church.

ours: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
theirs: Demetrius hath good report of all [men], and of the truth itself: yea, and we [also] bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

ours: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
theirs: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace [be] to thee. [Our] friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.

ours: JUDE, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:
theirs: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, [and] called:

ours: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
theirs: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort [you] that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

ours: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
theirs: Likewise also these [filthy] dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.

ours: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
theirs: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds [they are] without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

ours: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
theirs: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard [speeches] which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

ours: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having mens persons in admiration because of advantage.
theirs: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling [words], having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.

ours: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
theirs: And others save with fear, pulling [them] out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

ours: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
theirs: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present [you] faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

ours: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
theirs: To the only wise God our Saviour, [be] glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

ours: THE Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
theirs: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified [it] by his angel unto his servant John:

ours: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
theirs: Blessed [is] he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time [is] at hand.

ours: JOHN to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
theirs: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace [be] unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;

ours: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
theirs: And from Jesus Christ, [who is] the faithful witness, [and] the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,

ours: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
theirs: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him [be] glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

ours: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
theirs: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they [also] which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.

ours: I was in the Spirit on the Lords day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
theirs: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

ours: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
theirs: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send [it] unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.

ours: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
theirs: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks [one] like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.

ours: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
theirs: His head and [his] hairs [were] white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes [were] as a flame of fire;

ours: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
theirs: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance [was] as the sun shineth in his strength.

ours: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
theirs: [I am] he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

ours: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my names sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
theirs: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.

ours: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
theirs: Nevertheless I have [somewhat] against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.

ours: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
theirs: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and [I know] the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but [are] the synagogue of Satan.

ours: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
theirs: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast [some] of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

ours: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satans seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
theirs: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, [even] where Satan's seat [is]: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas [was] my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.

ours: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.
theirs: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth [it].

ours: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
theirs: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet [are] like fine brass;

ours: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.
theirs: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last [to be] more than the first.

ours: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.
theirs: But that which ye have [already] hold fast till I come.

ours: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
theirs: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, [which is] new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and [I will write upon him] my new name.

ours: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
theirs: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and [that] the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.

ours: AFTER this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.
theirs: After this I looked, and, behold, a door [was] opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard [was] as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.

ours: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
theirs: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and [one] sat on the throne.

ours: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
theirs: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and [there was] a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.

ours: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
theirs: And round about the throne [were] four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.

ours: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
theirs: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and [there were] seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

ours: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
theirs: And before the throne [there was] a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, [were] four beasts full of eyes before and behind.

ours: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
theirs: And the first beast [was] like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast [was] like a flying eagle.

ours: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
theirs: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about [him]; and [they were] full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

ours: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
theirs: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four [and] twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

ours: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
theirs: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, [be] unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.

ours: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.
theirs: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four [and] twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.

ours: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
theirs: And there went out another horse [that was] red: and [power] was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.

ours: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
theirs: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and [see] thou hurt not the oil and the wine.

ours: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
theirs: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they [were], should be fulfilled.

ours: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.
theirs: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: [and there were] sealed an hundred [and] forty [and] four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.

ours: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
theirs: Of the tribe of Juda [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad [were] sealed twelve thousand.

ours: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
theirs: Of the tribe of Aser [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses [were] sealed twelve thousand.

ours: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
theirs: Of the tribe of Simeon [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar [were] sealed twelve thousand.

ours: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
theirs: Of the tribe of Zabulon [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph [were] sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin [were] sealed twelve thousand.

ours: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
theirs: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and [about] the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

ours: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.
theirs: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, [be] unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

ours: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
theirs: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer [it] with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

ours: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angels hand.
theirs: And the smoke of the incense, [which came] with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.

ours: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
theirs: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast [it] into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

ours: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
theirs: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment [was] as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.

ours: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
theirs: And the shapes of the locusts [were] like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads [were] as it were crowns like gold, and their faces [were] as the faces of men.

ours: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
theirs: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as [the teeth] of lions.

ours: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
theirs: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings [was] as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.

ours: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
theirs: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power [was] to hurt men five months.

ours: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.
theirs: And they had a king over them, [which is] the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue [is] Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath [his] name Apollyon.

ours: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
theirs: One woe is past; [and], behold, there come two woes more hereafter.

ours: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
theirs: And the number of the army of the horsemen [were] two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.

ours: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
theirs: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses [were] as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

ours: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
theirs: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails [were] like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.

ours: AND I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
theirs: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow [was] upon his head, and his face [was] as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

ours: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
theirs: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and [his] left [foot] on the earth,

ours: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
theirs: And cried with a loud voice, as [when] a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.

ours: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.
theirs: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go [and] take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.

ours: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.
theirs: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take [it], and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.

ours: And I took the little book out of the angels hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
theirs: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.

ours: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
theirs: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty [and] two months.

ours: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
theirs: And I will give [power] unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred [and] threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

ours: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
theirs: And their dead bodies [shall lie] in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

ours: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.
theirs: The second woe is past; [and], behold, the third woe cometh quickly.

ours: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
theirs: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become [the kingdoms] of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

ours: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.
theirs: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and [to] his throne.

ours: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.
theirs: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred [and] threescore days.

ours: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.
